jobs.description:
The IT department, a part of IS/IT, are responsible for architecture, strategy, maintenance and support of Sobi information systems and IT infrastructure as clients, servers, network and other infrastructure equipment.
 The IT department consist of four teams – IT Operations, Infrastructure & Cyber security, Digital Workplace and Automation & Integration.All IT activities are performed in accordance with Sobi’s quality framework (GxP) and applicable regulatory and authority requirements.
 Within this context, the Digital Workplace & AI function plays a key role in enabling secure, compliant, and scalable digital solutions across Sobi. Under the leadership of the Head of Digital Workplace & AI, the team is responsible for developing and advancing Sobi’s Digital Workplace, Microsoft 365 platform, and enterprise AI capabilities. This includes setting strategic direction, defining objectives, and delivering modern, AI-enabled tools that support collaboration, productivity, and innovation across the organization.
 Main responsibilities:

• Develop and maintain enterprise-grade AI applications built on Azure OpenAI, including chat interfaces, document processing pipelines (RAG), and real-time collaboration features

• Design and implement Azure cloud solutions leveraging Azure Cosmos DB, Azure Cognitive Search, Azure Blob Storage, Azure Document Intelligence, and Azure AI Search

• Build and optimize full-stack applications using Next.js 14, React 18, TypeScript, and modern frontend/backend patterns (App Router, Server Components, Server Actions)

• Optimize AI/LLM integrations, including prompt engineering, token management, streaming completions, and multi-model AI orchestration

• Ensure code quality, security, and compliance through code reviews, testing, documentation, and adherence to Sobi's quality framework (GxP)

• Work proactively with ServiceNow to resolve incoming bug reports and other issues

• 4+ years of professional experience working as a software developer

• React / Next JS / Typescript / Azure Knowledge

• Proven ability to work autonomously and take ownership of features from concept to deployment

• Hands-on experience with Azure cloud services (Cosmos DB, Azure OpenAI, Cognitive Search, Blob Storage)

• Experience building and maintaining full-stack applications in production environment

• AI / LLM / Agent experience

• Fluent in English (written and spoken)
 Ideally you bring also:

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field (or equivalent practical experience)

• Experience in healthcare, pharmaceutical, or regulated industries preferred

How to apply
 We have an ongoing selection process in this recruitment and ask you to send your application as soon as possible. Click apply and include your resume in English.
 Why Join Us?
 Here at Sobi, our mission and culture get us excited to come to work every day, but here are a few more reasons to join our team:

• Emphasis on work/life balance

• Collaborative and team-oriented environment

• Opportunities for professional growth

• Diversity and Inclusion

• Competitive compensation for your work

• Making a positive impact to help ultra-rare disease patients who are in need of life saving treatments
 We are a global company with over 1,800 employees in more than 30 countries and are committed to the societies where we operate. With a deeply skilled management team directing our day-to-day wins, and a Board with a stellar track record, we’re ready to take on the world’s diseases, ailments and adversity. Our people believe they have the power to make a positive impact in others’ lives because that’s exactly what we do here. If you’re seeking a career that taps into your talents in a way that makes the world a better, healthier place, we just may have a job for you.

We know our employees are our most valuable asset, and our culture conveys that. We offer a competitive benefits package, to support the health and happiness of our staff.

Sobi Culture

At Sobi, we refuse to accept the status quo. This is because we have witnessed first-hand the challenges facing those affected by rare diseases and have used this knowledge to shape our business to find new ways of helping them.

As a specialized biopharmaceutical company, we are dedicated to rare diseases. And we see this focus as a strength. By effectively turning our research into ground-breaking treatments, we help make medicine more accessible and open up more possibilities for patients and more opportunities for those caring for them. This has been our approach since day one, but we know we can’t change the world of rare diseases on our own. Accomplishing this requires strong partnerships with patients, partners and stakeholders across the entire value chain. Together, we define how our business can create solutions that serve the needs of those affected by rare diseases while facilitating sustainable growth.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Il reparto IT, parte di IS/IT, è responsabile per l'architettura, la strategia, la manutenzione e il supporto dei sistemi informativi Sobi e dell'infrastruttura IT come clienti, server, rete e altre attrezzature infrastrutturali. Il reparto IT è composto da quattro team – IT Operations, Infrastructure & Cyber Security, Digital Workplace e Automation & Integration. Tutte le attività IT sono svolte in conformità con il framework di qualità di Sobi (GxP) e i requisiti di regolamentazione e autorità applicabili. In questo contesto, la funzione Digital Workplace & AI svolge un ruolo chiave nel consentire soluzioni digitali sicure, conformi e scalabili in Sobi. Sotto la guida del Head of Digital Workplace & AI, il team è responsabile dello sviluppo e dell'avanzamento della piattaforma Digital Workplace di Sobi, della piattaforma Microsoft 365 e delle capacità AI aziendali. Questo include l'impostazione di direzione strategica, la definizione degli obiettivi e la fornitura di strumenti moderni e abilitati all'intelligenza artificiale che supportano la collaborazione, la produttività e l'innovazione in tutta l'organizzazione. Principali responsabilità:
• Sviluppare e mantenere le applicazioni AI di livello enterprise costruite su Azure OpenAI, comprese le interfacce di chat, le pipeline di elaborazione dei documenti (RAG), e le funzionalità di collaborazione in tempo reale
• Progettazione e realizzazione di soluzioni cloud Azure sfruttando Azure Cosmos DB, Azure Cognitive Search, Azure Blob Storage, Azure Document Intelligence e Azure AI Search
• Costruire e ottimizzare le applicazioni full-stack utilizzando i modelli Next.js 14, React 18, TypeScript e frontnd/backend moderni (App Router, Server Components, Server Actions)
• Ottimizzare le integrazioni AI/LLM, tra cui ingegneria rapida, gestione dei gettoni, completamento dello streaming e orchestrazione AI multi-model
• Assicurare la qualità del codice, la sicurezza e la conformità attraverso le recensioni dei codici, i test, la documentazione e l'adesione al framework di qualità di Sobi (GxP)
• Lavorare proattivamente con ServiceNow per risolvere i report dei bug in arrivo e altri problemi
• 4+ anni di esperienza professionale che lavorano come sviluppatore software
• Reagire / Successivo JS / Tiposcritto / Conoscenza Azure
• Prova capacità di lavorare autonomamente e prendere la proprietà delle caratteristiche dal concetto alla distribuzione
• Esperienza pratica con servizi cloud Azure (Cosmos DB, Azure OpenAI, Ricerca cognitiva, Blob Storage)
• Esperienza di costruzione e mantenimento di applicazioni a pieno carico in ambiente di produzione
• AI / LLM / Esperienza agente
• Fluente in inglese (scritto e parlato) Idealmente si porta anche:
• Laurea o Master in Informatica, Ingegneria del Software, o campo relativo (o esperienza pratica equivalente)
• Esperienza nelle industrie farmaceutiche, farmaceutiche o regolamentate Come applicare Abbiamo un processo di selezione in corso in questo reclutamento e vi chiediamo di inviare la vostra domanda il prima possibile. Fare clic su applicare e includere il tuo curriculum in inglese. Perché unirsi a noi? Qui a Sobi, la nostra missione e la nostra cultura ci eccitano a venire al lavoro ogni giorno, ma qui ci sono alcune altre ragioni per unirsi al nostro team:
• enfasi sull'equilibrio del lavoro/vita
• Ambiente collaborativo e orientato al team
• Opportunità di crescita professionale
• Diversità e inclusione
• Compensazione competitiva per il vostro lavoro
• Fare un impatto positivo per aiutare i pazienti con malattie ultra rare che hanno bisogno di trattamenti di salvataggio Siamo una società globale con oltre 1.800 dipendenti in oltre 30 paesi e siamo impegnati nelle società in cui operiamo. Con un team di gestione profondamente qualificato che dirige le nostre vincite quotidiane, e un Board con un record di traccia stellare, siamo pronti a prendere le malattie del mondo, disturbi e avversità. La nostra gente crede di avere il potere di avere un impatto positivo nella vita degli altri perché è esattamente quello che facciamo qui. Se siete alla ricerca di una carriera che tocca i vostri talenti in un modo che rende il mondo un posto migliore, più sano, possiamo solo avere un lavoro per voi. Sappiamo che i nostri dipendenti sono il nostro bene più prezioso, e la nostra cultura lo trasmette. Offriamo un pacchetto di benefici competitivi, per sostenere la salute e la felicità del nostro personale. Sobi Cultura A Sobi, ci rifiutiamo di accettare lo status quo. Questo perché abbiamo assistito in prima persona alle sfide che le persone colpite da malattie rare e abbiamo usato questa conoscenza per plasmare la nostra attività per trovare nuovi modi di aiutarli. Come azienda biofarmaceutica specializzata, siamo dedicati a malattie rare. E vediamo questo obiettivo come una forza. Trasformando efficacemente la nostra ricerca in trattamenti innovativi, aiutiamo a rendere la medicina più accessibile e aprire più possibilità per i pazienti e più opportunità per coloro che li curano. Questo è stato il nostro approccio dal primo giorno, ma sappiamo che non possiamo cambiare il mondo di malattie rare da soli. L'integrazione richiede forti partnership con pazienti, partner e stakeholder in tutta la catena del valore. Insieme, definiamo come il nostro business può creare soluzioni che servono le esigenze di coloro che sono colpiti da malattie rare, facilitando la crescita sostenibile.

Die IT-Abteilung, ein Teil von IS/IT, ist für Architektur, Strategie, Wartung und Unterstützung von Sobi-Informationssystemen und IT-Infrastruktur als Kunden, Server, Netzwerk und andere Infrastrukturausrüstungen verantwortlich. Die IT-Abteilung besteht aus vier Teams – IT Operations, Infrastruktur & Cyber Security, Digital Workplace und Automation & Integration. Alle IT-Aktivitäten werden gemäß dem Qualitätsrahmen von Sobi (GxP) und den geltenden Regulierungs- und Behördenanforderungen durchgeführt. In diesem Zusammenhang spielt die Digital Workplace & AI-Funktion eine zentrale Rolle, um sichere, konforme und skalierbare digitale Lösungen über Sobi zu ermöglichen. Unter der Leitung des Leiters Digital Workplace & AI ist das Team für die Entwicklung und Entwicklung von Sobi’s Digital Workplace, Microsoft 365 Plattform und Enterprise AI-Fähigkeiten verantwortlich. Dazu gehören die strategische Ausrichtung, die Festlegung von Zielen und die Bereitstellung moderner, AI-fähige Werkzeuge, die die Zusammenarbeit, Produktivität und Innovation in der gesamten Organisation unterstützen. Hauptverantwortlichkeiten:
• Entwicklung und Pflege von auf Azure OpenAI basierenden Anwendungen im Bereich der Unternehmensqualität, einschließlich Chat-Schnittstellen, Dokumentenverarbeitungspipeline (RAG) und Echtzeit-Zusammenarbeit
• Entwicklung und Implementierung von Azure Cloud-Lösungen mit Azure Cosmos DB, Azure Cognitive Search, Azure Blob Storage, Azure Document Intelligence und Azure AI Search
• Erstellen und optimieren Sie Full-Stack-Anwendungen mit Next.js 14, React 18, TypeScript und moderne Frontend/Backd-Muster (App Router, Server Components, Server Actions)
• Optimieren von KI/LLM-Integrationen, einschließlich Schnelltechnik, Tokenmanagement, Streaming-Vervollständigungen und Multi-Modell AI-Orchestrierung
• Gewährleistung von Codequalität, Sicherheit und Compliance durch Code-Bewertungen, Tests, Dokumentation und Einhaltung des Qualitätsrahmens von Sobi (GxP)
• Proaktiv mit ServiceNow arbeiten, um eingehende Fehlerberichte und andere Probleme zu lösen
• 4+ Jahre Berufserfahrung als Software-Entwickler
• React / Next JS / Typescript / Azure Knowledge
• bewährte Fähigkeit, autonom zu arbeiten und Eigentum an Funktionen von Konzept zu Einsatz zu nehmen
• Hand-on-Erfahrung mit Azure-Cloud-Services (Cosmos DB, Azure OpenAI, Kognitive Suche, Blob Storage)
• Erleben Sie den Aufbau und die Aufrechterhaltung vollstackiger Anwendungen im Produktionsumfeld
• AI / LLM / Agent Experience
• fließend auf Englisch (schriftlich und gesprochen) Idealerweise bringen Sie auch:
• Bachelor- oder Master-Abschluss in Informatik, Software Engineering oder verwandten Bereich (oder gleichwertige praktische Erfahrung)
• Erfahrung in der medizinischen, pharmazeutischen oder regulierten Industrie Wie anzuwenden Wir haben einen fortlaufenden Auswahlprozess bei dieser Rekrutierung und bitten Sie, Ihre Bewerbung so schnell wie möglich zu senden. Klicken Sie auf Bewerben und schließen Sie Ihren Lebenslauf in Englisch ein. Warum bei uns? Hier bei Sobi erregt uns unsere Mission und Kultur, jeden Tag zur Arbeit zu kommen, aber hier sind noch ein paar Gründe, sich unserem Team anzuschließen:
• Schwerpunkt Arbeits- und Lebensbilanz
• Zusammenarbeit und teamorientierte Umgebung
• Möglichkeiten für professionelles Wachstum
• Vielfalt und Inklusion
• Wettbewerbsausgleich für Ihre Arbeit
• Positive Auswirkungen auf ultra-rassige Patienten, die lebensrettende Behandlungen benötigen Wir sind ein globales Unternehmen mit über 1.800 Mitarbeitern in mehr als 30 Ländern und sind den Gesellschaften verpflichtet, in denen wir tätig sind. Mit einem hochqualifizierten Management-Team, das unsere Tagessiege leitet, und einem Board mit einem stellaren Track-Record, sind wir bereit, die weltweit Krankheiten, Beschwerden und Gegner anzunehmen. Unsere Leute glauben, dass sie die Macht haben, positive Auswirkungen auf das Leben anderer zu machen, weil genau das, was wir hier tun. Wenn Sie auf der Suche nach einer Karriere sind, die Ihre Talente in einer Weise, die die Welt zu einem besseren, gesünderen Ort macht, können wir einfach einen Job für Sie haben. Wir wissen, dass unsere Mitarbeiter unser wertvollstes Gut sind, und unsere Kultur vermittelt das. Wir bieten ein wettbewerbsfähiges Leistungspaket, um die Gesundheit und das Glück unserer Mitarbeiter zu unterstützen. Sobi Kultur Bei Sobi weigern wir uns, den Status quo zu akzeptieren. Dies liegt daran, dass wir die Herausforderungen, denen seltene Krankheiten ausgesetzt sind, aus erster Hand erlebt haben und dieses Wissen genutzt haben, um unser Geschäft zu gestalten, um neue Wege zu finden, ihnen zu helfen. Als spezialisiertes biopharmazeutisches Unternehmen widmen wir uns seltenen Krankheiten. Und wir sehen diesen Fokus als Stärke. Indem wir unsere Forschung effektiv in bahnbrechende Behandlungen verwandeln, helfen wir, die Medizin zugänglicher zu machen und mehr Möglichkeiten für Patienten und mehr Möglichkeiten für die Pflege für sie zu eröffnen. Dies ist unser Ansatz seit dem ersten Tag, aber wir wissen, dass wir die Welt der seltenen Krankheiten nicht allein verändern können. Dazu kommen starke Partnerschaften mit Patienten, Partnern und Stakeholdern in der gesamten Wertschöpfungskette. Gemeinsam definieren wir, wie unser Unternehmen Lösungen schaffen kann, die den Bedürfnissen der Betroffenen von seltenen Krankheiten dienen und ein nachhaltiges Wachstum ermöglichen.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Le service informatique, qui fait partie des SI/TI, est responsable de l'architecture, de la stratégie, de la maintenance et du soutien des systèmes d'information de Sobi et de l'infrastructure informatique en tant que clients, serveurs, réseaux et autres équipements d'infrastructure. Le département informatique se compose de quatre équipes : opérations informatiques, infrastructure et cybersécurité, milieu de travail numérique et automatisation et intégration. Toutes les activités de TI sont exécutées conformément au cadre de qualité (GxP) de Sobi et aux exigences réglementaires et administratives applicables. Dans ce contexte, la fonction Digital Workplace & AI joue un rôle clé en permettant des solutions numériques sûres, conformes et évolutives dans l'ensemble de Sobi. Sous la direction du chef du bureau numérique et de l'IA, l'équipe est chargée de développer et de faire progresser les capacités de bureau numérique de Sobi, la plateforme Microsoft 365 et l'IA d'entreprise. Cela comprend l'établissement d'orientations stratégiques, la définition d'objectifs et la prestation d'outils modernes axés sur l'IA qui appuient la collaboration, la productivité et l'innovation dans l'ensemble de l'organisation. Principales responsabilités :
• Développer et entretenir des applications d'IA de qualité entreprise basées sur Azure OpenAI, y compris des interfaces de chat, des pipelines de traitement de documents (RAG) et des fonctions de collaboration en temps réel
• Conception et mise en œuvre de solutions de cloud Azure en utilisant Azure Cosmos DB, Azure Cognitive Search, Azure Blob Storage, Azure Document Intelligence et Azure AI Search
• Construisez et optimisez les applications complètes en utilisant Next.js 14, React 18, TypeScript, et les modèles frontend/backend modernes (App Router, composants serveur, actions serveur)
• Optimiser les intégrations AI/LLM, y compris l'ingénierie rapide, la gestion des jetons, les finitions en streaming et l'orchestration d'IA multi-modèles
• Assurer la qualité, la sécurité et la conformité des codes par des examens, des tests, de la documentation et le respect du cadre de qualité de Sobi (GxP)
• Travailler de manière proactive avec ServiceNow pour résoudre les rapports de bogues entrants et d'autres problèmes
• 4 ans d'expérience professionnelle en tant que développeur de logiciels
• Réagir / Suivant JS / Typescript / Azure Knowledge
• Capacité éprouvée de travailler de manière autonome et de prendre en charge les caractéristiques du concept au déploiement
• Expérience pratique avec les services de cloud Azure (Cosmos DB, Azure OpenAI, Recherche cognitive, Stockage Blob)
• Expérience de la construction et du maintien d'applications complètes dans l'environnement de production
• Expérience d'IA / LLM / Agent
• Fluent en anglais (écrit et parlé) Idéalement vous apportez aussi:
• Baccalauréat ou maîtrise en informatique, génie logiciel ou domaine connexe (ou expérience pratique équivalente)
• Expérience dans les secteurs des soins de santé, des produits pharmaceutiques ou réglementés Comment présenter une demande Nous avons un processus de sélection continu dans ce recrutement et vous demandons d'envoyer votre candidature dès que possible. Cliquez sur appliquer et inclure votre CV en anglais. Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? Ici à Sobi, notre mission et notre culture nous incitent à venir travailler tous les jours, mais voici quelques autres raisons de rejoindre notre équipe :
• Mettre l'accent sur l'équilibre entre vie professionnelle et vie privée
• Environnement collaboratif et axé sur l'équipe
• Possibilités de croissance professionnelle
• Diversité et inclusion
• Compensation compétitive de votre travail
• Faire un impact positif pour aider les patients atteints de maladies ultra-rares qui ont besoin de traitements vitaux Nous sommes une entreprise mondiale avec plus de 1800 employés dans plus de 30 pays et sommes engagés dans les sociétés où nous opérons. Avec une équipe de gestion profondément qualifiée dirigeant nos victoires quotidiennes, et un conseil avec un bilan stellaire, nous sommes prêts à prendre sur le monde des maladies, des maladies et de l'adversité. Notre peuple croit qu'il a le pouvoir d'avoir un impact positif sur les autres, parce que c'est exactement ce que nous faisons ici. Si vous cherchez une carrière qui tire profit de vos talents d'une manière qui fait du monde un endroit meilleur et plus sain, nous pouvons juste avoir un emploi pour vous. Nous savons que nos employés sont notre atout le plus précieux, et notre culture le démontre. Nous offrons un ensemble d'avantages concurrentiels pour soutenir la santé et le bonheur de notre personnel. Culture sobi Chez Sobi, nous refusons le statu quo. C'est parce que nous avons été témoins de première main des défis auxquels sont confrontés les personnes touchées par des maladies rares et que nous avons utilisé ces connaissances pour façonner notre entreprise afin de trouver de nouvelles façons de les aider. En tant qu'entreprise biopharmaceutique spécialisée, nous sommes dédiés aux maladies rares. Et nous voyons cet accent comme une force. En transformant efficacement nos recherches en traitements révolutionnaires, nous aidons à rendre la médecine plus accessible et à ouvrir davantage de possibilités aux patients et à ceux qui s'en occupent. C'est notre approche depuis le premier jour, mais nous savons que nous ne pouvons pas changer le monde des maladies rares nous-mêmes. Pour y parvenir, il faut établir des partenariats solides avec les patients, les partenaires et les intervenants dans toute la chaîne de valeur. Ensemble, nous définissons comment notre entreprise peut créer des solutions qui répondent aux besoins des personnes touchées par des maladies rares tout en facilitant une croissance durable.

jobs.description:
About the role
 As Senior Manager, Global Strategic Sourcing, you will play an important role in shaping how Sobi builds a resilient, sustainable, and forward-looking supply network. Working across innovation, manufacturing, and commercial functions, you will help connect strategy with execution and influence sourcing decisions that support both our business and the patients we serve globally.
 You will join our Global Strategic Sourcing & Direct Procurement team, report to the VP Global Strategic Sourcing, and this Hybrid role will be based at our Stockholm HQ or Global Hub in Basel.
 In this role, you will:

• Lead the development and execution of global sourcing strategies that enable a resilient, cost-efficient, and sustainable supply network for Sobi’s clinical and commercial manufacturing.

• Combine a strategic and commercial mindset to evaluate and optimize sourcing decisions throughout the product lifecycle — from development to commercialization and life-cycle management.

• Drive cross-functional collaboration across Technical Operations, Legal, Tax, Finance, and other key stakeholders to negotiate and implement complex, high-value global contracts.

• Design and maintain a strategic sourcing roadmap, ensuring alignment with Sobi’s business goals and long-term vision.

• Contribute to due diligence efforts in business development projects, providing critical input on manufacturing and sourcing opportunities.

• Anticipate market trends and assess supplier capabilities to deliver data-driven sourcing recommendations that strengthen Sobi’s competitive edge.

• Lead business cases for Technical Operations projects, from financial approval through to contract execution, and continuously enhance sourcing processes and procurement policies to drive efficiency and innovation.

About you
 You bring a thoughtful mix of strategic perspective and practical execution. You are comfortable working across functions, building trust, and navigating complexity in an international environment. Just as importantly, you are someone who brings curiosity, sound judgment, and a collaborative mindset—someone who enjoys turning ideas into action and creating impact together with others.
 Key Qualifications

• A university degree in Business, Chemistry, Science, Industrial Engineering, or another relevant field.

• Experience from the pharmaceutical or biotech industry, ideally within sourcing, procurement, or outsourced manufacturing.

• Proven success negotiating fact-based complex, high-value global contracts in a multicultural setting.

• Understanding cGMP manufacturing and global regulatory standards.

• Experience in global, matrixed organizations and cross-functional collaboration.
 Skills & Knowledge:

• Excellent communication skills in English (written and spoken).

• Strong financial and analytical acumen (COGS and cost structures).

• Expertise in global sourcing strategies and supplier performance management.

• Exceptional commercial mindset and business judgment.
 Here at Sobi we live by our core values: Care, Ambition, Urgency, Ownership and Partnership!

How to apply
 We have an ongoing selection process in this recruitment and ask you to send your application as soon as possible. Click apply and include your resume.
 Why Join Us?
 Here at Sobi, our mission and culture get us excited to come to work every day, but here are a few more reasons to join our team:

• Collaborative and team-oriented environment

• Opportunities for professional growth

• Diversity and Inclusion

• Competitive compensation for your work

• Making a positive impact to help ultra-rare disease patients who are in need of life saving treatments

• Emphasis on work/life balance

Sobi is a global company with over 1,900 employees in more than 30 countries and are committed to the societies where we operate. We are a specialised international biopharmaceutical company transforming the lives of people with rare and debilitating diseases, providing reliable access to innovative medicines in the areas of haematology, immunology, and specialty care. Sobi’s share is listed on Nasdaq Stockholm. More about Sobi at sobi.com and LinkedIn.

We know our employees are our most valuable asset and our culture conveys that. We offer a competitive benefits package, to support the health and happiness of our staff.

Sobi Culture

At Sobi, we refuse to accept the status quo. This is because we have witnessed first-hand the challenges facing those affected by rare diseases and have used this knowledge to shape our business to find new ways of helping them.

As a specialized biopharmaceutical company, we are dedicated to rare diseases. And we see this focus as a strength. By effectively turning our research into ground-breaking treatments, we help make medicine more accessible and open more possibilities for patients and more opportunities for those caring for them. This has been our approach since day one, but we know we can’t change the world of rare diseases on our own. Accomplishing this requires strong partnerships with patients, partners and stakeholders across the entire value chain. Together, we define how our business can create solutions that serve the needs of those affected by rare diseases while facilitating sustainable growth.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Informazioni sul ruolo In qualità di Senior Manager, Global Strategic Sourcing, svolgerai un ruolo importante nel definire il modo in cui Sobi costruisce una rete di fornitura resiliente, sostenibile e lungimirante. Lavorando nell'ambito dell'innovazione, della produzione e delle funzioni commerciali, aiuterai a collegare la strategia con l'esecuzione e influenzerai le decisioni di approvvigionamento che supportano sia la nostra attività che i pazienti che serviamo a livello globale. Entrerai a far parte del nostro team di Global Strategic Sourcing e Direct Procurement, riferirai al VP Global Strategic Sourcing e questo ruolo ibrido avrà sede presso il nostro quartier generale di Stoccolma o il Global Hub di Basilea. In questo ruolo:
• Guidare lo sviluppo e l'esecuzione di strategie di approvvigionamento globale che consentano una rete di fornitura resiliente, economicamente vantaggiosa e sostenibile per la produzione clinica e commerciale di Sobi.
• Combinare una mentalità strategica e commerciale per valutare e ottimizzare le decisioni di approvvigionamento durante l'intero ciclo di vita del prodotto, dallo sviluppo alla commercializzazione e alla gestione del ciclo di vita.
• Promuovere la collaborazione interfunzionale tra operazioni tecniche, legali, fiscali, finanziarie e altre parti interessate chiave per negoziare e implementare contratti globali complessi e di alto valore.
• Progettare e mantenere una roadmap di approvvigionamento strategico, garantendo l'allineamento con gli obiettivi aziendali e la visione a lungo termine di Sobi.
• Contribuire agli sforzi di due diligence nei progetti di sviluppo aziendale, fornendo input critici sulle opportunità di produzione e approvvigionamento.
• Anticipare le tendenze del mercato e valutare le capacità dei fornitori per fornire raccomandazioni di approvvigionamento basate sui dati che rafforzano il vantaggio competitivo di Sobi.
• Condurre casi aziendali per progetti di operazioni tecniche, dall'approvazione finanziaria fino all'esecuzione del contratto, e migliorare continuamente i processi di approvvigionamento e le politiche di approvvigionamento per promuovere l'efficienza e l'innovazione. Informazioni su di te Porta un mix ponderato di prospettiva strategica ed esecuzione pratica. Ti senti a tuo agio nel lavorare tra più funzioni, creare fiducia e affrontare la complessità in un ambiente internazionale. Altrettanto importante, sei qualcuno che porta curiosità, buon giudizio e una mentalità collaborativa, qualcuno a cui piace trasformare le idee in azioni e creare impatto insieme agli altri. Qualifiche chiave
• Una laurea in Economia, Chimica, Scienze, Ingegneria Industriale o un altro campo pertinente.
• Esperienza nel settore farmaceutico o biotecnologico, idealmente nell'ambito dell'approvvigionamento, dell'approvvigionamento o della produzione in outsourcing.
• Comprovato successo nella negoziazione di contratti globali complessi e di alto valore basati sui fatti in un contesto multiculturale.
• Comprendere la produzione cGMP e gli standard normativi globali.
• Esperienza in organizzazioni globali a matrice e collaborazione interfunzionale. Competenze e conoscenze:
• Eccellenti capacità di comunicazione in inglese (scritto e parlato).
• Forte acume finanziario e analitico (COGS e strutture dei costi).
• Competenza nelle strategie di approvvigionamento globale e nella gestione delle prestazioni dei fornitori.
• Mentalità commerciale e giudizio aziendale eccezionali. Qui a Sobi viviamo secondo i nostri valori fondamentali: cura, ambizione, urgenza, proprietà e partnership! Come candidarsi Abbiamo un processo di selezione in corso per questo reclutamento e ti chiediamo di inviare la tua candidatura il prima possibile. Fai clic su Applica e includi il tuo curriculum. Perché unirsi a noi? Qui a Sobi, la nostra missione e cultura ci rendono entusiasti di venire al lavoro ogni giorno, ma ecco alcuni altri motivi per entrare a far parte del nostro team:
• Ambiente collaborativo e orientato al team
• Opportunità di crescita professionale
• Diversità e inclusione
• Compensazione competitiva per il tuo lavoro
• Avere un impatto positivo per aiutare i pazienti affetti da malattie ultra rare che necessitano di trattamenti salvavita
• Enfasi sull'equilibrio tra lavoro e vita privata Sobi è un'azienda globale con oltre 1.900 dipendenti in più di 30 paesi e si impegna alle società in cui operiamo. Siamo un’azienda biofarmaceutica internazionale specializzata che trasforma la vita delle persone affette da malattie rare e debilitanti, fornendo un accesso affidabile a farmaci innovativi nei settori dell’ematologia, dell’immunologia e delle cure specialistiche. Le azioni di Sobi sono quotate al Nasdaq di Stoccolma. Maggiori informazioni su Sobi su sobi.com e LinkedIn. Sappiamo che i nostri dipendenti sono la nostra risorsa più preziosa e la nostra cultura lo trasmette. Offriamo un pacchetto di vantaggi competitivi, per sostenere la salute e la felicità del nostro personale. Cultura Sobi Noi di Sobi ci rifiutiamo di accettare lo status quo. Questo perché siamo stati testimoni in prima persona delle sfide che devono affrontare le persone affette da malattie rare e abbiamo utilizzato questa conoscenza per modellare la nostra attività per trovare nuovi modi per aiutarli. In qualità di azienda biofarmaceutica specializzata, ci dedichiamo alle malattie rare. E vediamo questa attenzione come un punto di forza. Trasformando efficacemente la nostra ricerca in trattamenti innovativi, contribuiamo a rendere la medicina più accessibile e ad aprire più possibilità ai pazienti e più opportunità a coloro che si prendono cura di loro. Questo è stato il nostro approccio fin dal primo giorno, ma sappiamo che non possiamo cambiare il mondo delle malattie rare da soli. Per raggiungere questo obiettivo sono necessarie forti collaborazioni con pazienti, partner e parti interessate lungo l’intera catena del valore. Insieme, definiamo come la nostra azienda può creare soluzioni che soddisfino le esigenze delle persone affette da malattie rare, facilitando al tempo stesso una crescita sostenibile.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Über die Rolle: Als Senior Manager, Global Strategic Sourcing, spielen Sie eine wichtige Rolle bei der Gestaltung, wie Sobi ein belastbares, nachhaltiges und zukunftsorientiertes Liefernetzwerk aufbaut. Sie arbeiten in den Bereichen Innovation, Fertigung und Vertrieb und helfen dabei, Strategie mit Umsetzung zu verbinden und Einfluss auf Beschaffungsentscheidungen zu nehmen, die sowohl unserem Geschäft als auch den Patienten, die wir weltweit betreuen, zugute kommen. Sie werden Teil unseres Teams „Global Strategic Sourcing & Direct Procurement“ sein, dem VP Global Strategic Sourcing Bericht erstatten und diese Hybridrolle wird in unserem Stockholmer Hauptsitz oder Global Hub in Basel angesiedelt sein. In dieser Rolle werden Sie:
• die Entwicklung und Umsetzung globaler Beschaffungsstrategien leiten, die ein belastbares, kosteneffizientes und nachhaltiges Liefernetzwerk für die klinische und kommerzielle Produktion von Sobi ermöglichen.
• Kombinieren Sie eine strategische und kommerzielle Denkweise, um Beschaffungsentscheidungen im gesamten Produktlebenszyklus zu bewerten und zu optimieren – von der Entwicklung über die Kommerzialisierung bis hin zum Lebenszyklusmanagement.
• Fördern Sie die funktionsübergreifende Zusammenarbeit zwischen Technik, Recht, Steuern, Finanzen und anderen wichtigen Interessengruppen, um komplexe, hochwertige globale Verträge auszuhandeln und umzusetzen.
• Entwerfen und pflegen Sie eine strategische Beschaffungs-Roadmap, um die Übereinstimmung mit den Geschäftszielen und der langfristigen Vision von Sobi sicherzustellen.
• Tragen Sie zu Due-Diligence-Bemühungen in Geschäftsentwicklungsprojekten bei und liefern Sie entscheidenden Input zu Herstellungs- und Beschaffungsmöglichkeiten.
• Antizipieren Sie Markttrends und bewerten Sie die Fähigkeiten der Lieferanten, um datengesteuerte Beschaffungsempfehlungen zu liefern, die den Wettbewerbsvorteil von Sobi stärken.
• Führen Sie Geschäftsfälle für technische Betriebsprojekte durch, von der finanziellen Genehmigung bis zur Vertragsausführung, und verbessern Sie kontinuierlich Beschaffungsprozesse und Beschaffungsrichtlinien, um Effizienz und Innovation voranzutreiben. Über Sie: Sie bringen eine durchdachte Mischung aus strategischer Perspektive und praktischer Umsetzung mit. Sie fühlen sich wohl dabei, funktionsübergreifend zu arbeiten, Vertrauen aufzubauen und die Komplexität in einem internationalen Umfeld zu meistern. Ebenso wichtig ist, dass Sie jemand sind, der Neugier, ein gesundes Urteilsvermögen und eine kooperative Denkweise mitbringt – jemand, der es genießt, Ideen in die Tat umzusetzen und gemeinsam mit anderen Wirkung zu erzielen. Schlüsselqualifikationen
• Ein Universitätsabschluss in Wirtschaft, Chemie, Naturwissenschaften, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder einem anderen relevanten Bereich.
• Erfahrung aus der Pharma- oder Biotech-Industrie, idealerweise in den Bereichen Beschaffung, Beschaffung oder ausgelagerte Fertigung.
• Nachgewiesener Erfolg bei der Aushandlung faktenbasierter, komplexer, hochwertiger globaler Verträge in einem multikulturellen Umfeld.
• Verständnis der cGMP-Herstellung und globaler Regulierungsstandards.
• Erfahrung in globalen, Matrixorganisationen und funktionsübergreifender Zusammenarbeit. Fähigkeiten und Kenntnisse:
• Ausgezeichnete Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Englisch (schriftlich und mündlich).
• Starker finanzieller und analytischer Scharfsinn (COGS und Kostenstrukturen).
• Fachkenntnisse in globalen Beschaffungsstrategien und Lieferantenleistungsmanagement.
• Außergewöhnliche kaufmännische Denkweise und unternehmerisches Urteilsvermögen. Hier bei Sobi leben wir nach unseren Grundwerten: Fürsorge, Ehrgeiz, Dringlichkeit, Eigenverantwortung und Partnerschaft! So bewerben Sie sich: Bei dieser Stellenbesetzung führen wir ein fortlaufendes Auswahlverfahren durch und bitten Sie, Ihre Bewerbung so schnell wie möglich abzusenden. Klicken Sie auf „Bewerben“ und fügen Sie Ihren Lebenslauf bei. Warum sollten Sie bei uns mitmachen? Hier bei Sobi freuen wir uns jeden Tag über unsere Mission und Kultur, zur Arbeit zu kommen, aber hier sind noch ein paar weitere Gründe, unserem Team beizutreten:
• Kollaboratives und teamorientiertes Umfeld
• Möglichkeiten zur beruflichen Weiterentwicklung
• Vielfalt und Inklusion
• Wettbewerbsfähige Vergütung für Ihre Arbeit
• Einen positiven Einfluss ausüben, um Patienten mit extrem seltenen Krankheiten zu helfen, die lebensrettende Behandlungen benötigen
• Schwerpunkt auf Work-Life-Balance Sobi ist ein globales Unternehmen mit über 1.900 Mitarbeitern in mehr als 30 Länder und engagieren uns für die Gesellschaften, in denen wir tätig sind. Wir sind ein spezialisiertes internationales biopharmazeutisches Unternehmen, das das Leben von Menschen mit seltenen und belastenden Krankheiten verändert und zuverlässigen Zugang zu innovativen Arzneimitteln in den Bereichen Hämatologie, Immunologie und Spezialversorgung bietet. Die Aktie von Sobi ist an der Nasdaq Stockholm notiert. Mehr über Sobi auf sobi.com und LinkedIn. Wir wissen, dass unsere Mitarbeiter unser wertvollstes Kapital sind, und unsere Kultur vermittelt dies. Wir bieten ein wettbewerbsfähiges Leistungspaket, um die Gesundheit und Zufriedenheit unserer Mitarbeiter zu unterstützen. Sobi-Kultur Bei Sobi weigern wir uns, den Status quo zu akzeptieren. Dies liegt daran, dass wir die Herausforderungen, vor denen die von seltenen Krankheiten Betroffenen stehen, aus erster Hand miterlebt haben und dieses Wissen genutzt haben, um unser Unternehmen so zu gestalten, dass neue Wege gefunden werden, ihnen zu helfen. Als spezialisiertes biopharmazeutisches Unternehmen widmen wir uns seltenen Krankheiten. Und wir sehen diesen Fokus als Stärke. Indem wir unsere Forschung effektiv in bahnbrechende Behandlungen umsetzen, tragen wir dazu bei, die Medizin zugänglicher zu machen und mehr Möglichkeiten für Patienten und mehr Chancen für ihre Betreuer zu eröffnen. Dies ist seit dem ersten Tag unser Ansatz, aber wir wissen, dass wir die Welt der seltenen Krankheiten nicht alleine verändern können. Um dies zu erreichen, sind starke Partnerschaften mit Patienten, Partnern und Interessengruppen entlang der gesamten Wertschöpfungskette erforderlich. Gemeinsam definieren wir, wie unser Unternehmen Lösungen schaffen kann, die den Bedürfnissen der von seltenen Krankheiten Betroffenen gerecht werden und gleichzeitig nachhaltiges Wachstum ermöglichen.

À propos du rôle En tant que responsable principal de l'approvisionnement stratégique mondial, vous jouerez un rôle important dans la manière dont Sobi construit un réseau d'approvisionnement résilient, durable et tourné vers l'avenir. En travaillant dans les fonctions d'innovation, de fabrication et commerciales, vous contribuerez à relier la stratégie à l'exécution et à influencer les décisions d'approvisionnement qui soutiennent à la fois notre entreprise et les patients que nous servons dans le monde. Vous rejoindrez notre équipe d'approvisionnement stratégique mondial et d'approvisionnement direct, relèverez du vice-président de l'approvisionnement stratégique mondial, et ce rôle hybride sera basé à notre siège de Stockholm ou à notre hub mondial à Bâle. Dans ce rôle, vous :
• Diriger le développement et l'exécution de stratégies d'approvisionnement mondiales qui permettent un réseau d'approvisionnement résilient, rentable et durable pour la fabrication clinique et commerciale de Sobi.
• Combiner un état d'esprit stratégique et commercial pour évaluer et optimiser les décisions d'approvisionnement tout au long du cycle de vie du produit, du développement à la commercialisation et à la gestion du cycle de vie.
• Favoriser la collaboration interfonctionnelle entre les opérations techniques, les services juridiques, fiscaux, financiers et d'autres parties prenantes clés pour négocier et mettre en œuvre des contrats mondiaux complexes et de grande valeur.
• Concevoir et maintenir une feuille de route d'approvisionnement stratégique, garantissant l'alignement avec les objectifs commerciaux et la vision à long terme de Sobi.
• Contribuer aux efforts de diligence raisonnable dans les projets de développement commercial, en fournissant une contribution essentielle sur les opportunités de fabrication et d'approvisionnement.
• Anticiper les tendances du marché et évaluer les capacités des fournisseurs pour fournir des recommandations d'approvisionnement basées sur les données qui renforcent l'avantage concurrentiel de Sobi.
• Diriger des analyses de rentabilisation pour les projets d'opérations techniques, de l'approbation financière jusqu'à l'exécution du contrat, et améliorer continuellement les processus d'approvisionnement et les politiques d'approvisionnement pour favoriser l'efficacité et l'innovation. À propos de vous Vous apportez un mélange réfléchi de perspective stratégique et d'exécution pratique. Vous êtes à l’aise de travailler entre plusieurs fonctions, d’instaurer la confiance et de naviguer dans la complexité dans un environnement international. Tout aussi important, vous êtes quelqu'un qui fait preuve de curiosité, d'un bon jugement et d'un état d'esprit collaboratif, quelqu'un qui aime transformer les idées en actions et créer un impact avec les autres. Qualifications clés un diplôme universitaire en commerce, chimie, sciences, génie industriel ou dans un autre domaine pertinent.
• Expérience de l'industrie pharmaceutique ou biotechnologique, idéalement dans le domaine du sourcing, de l'approvisionnement ou de la fabrication externalisée.
• Succès avéré dans la négociation de contrats mondiaux complexes et de grande valeur fondés sur des faits dans un environnement multiculturel.
• Comprendre la fabrication cGMP et les normes réglementaires mondiales.
• Expérience dans des organisations mondiales matricielles et une collaboration interfonctionnelle. Compétences et connaissances :
• Excellentes compétences en communication en anglais (écrit et parlé).
• Fort sens financier et analytique (COGS et structures de coûts).
• Expertise dans les stratégies d'approvisionnement mondiales et la gestion de la performance des fournisseurs.
• Esprit commercial et jugement d'affaires exceptionnels. Chez Sobi, nous vivons selon nos valeurs fondamentales : soins, ambition, urgence, appropriation et partenariat ! Comment postuler Nous avons un processus de sélection en cours pour ce recrutement et vous demandons d'envoyer votre candidature le plus tôt possible. Cliquez sur postuler et incluez votre CV. Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? Chez Sobi, notre mission et notre culture nous donnent envie de venir travailler chaque jour, mais voici quelques raisons supplémentaires de rejoindre notre équipe :
• Environnement collaboratif et axé sur l'équipe
• Possibilités de croissance professionnelle
• Diversité et inclusion
• Rémunération compétitive pour votre travail
• Avoir un impact positif pour aider les patients atteints de maladies ultra-rares qui ont besoin de traitements vitaux
• L'accent est mis sur l'équilibre travail/vie privée Sobi est une entreprise mondiale avec plus de 1 900 employés dans plus de 30 pays et nous nous engageons envers les sociétés dans lesquelles nous opérons. Nous sommes une société biopharmaceutique internationale spécialisée qui transforme la vie des personnes atteintes de maladies rares et débilitantes, en offrant un accès fiable à des médicaments innovants dans les domaines de l'hématologie, de l'immunologie et des soins spécialisés. L’action Sobi est cotée au Nasdaq Stockholm. Pour en savoir plus sur Sobi, visitez sobi.com et LinkedIn. Nous savons que nos employés sont notre atout le plus précieux et notre culture le reflète. Nous offrons un ensemble d'avantages sociaux compétitifs, pour soutenir la santé et le bonheur de notre personnel. Culture Sobi Chez Sobi, nous refusons d'accepter le statu quo. En effet, nous avons été témoins des défis auxquels sont confrontées les personnes touchées par des maladies rares et avons utilisé ces connaissances pour façonner notre entreprise afin de trouver de nouvelles façons de les aider. En tant qu’entreprise biopharmaceutique spécialisée, nous nous consacrons aux maladies rares. Et nous considérons cette concentration comme une force. En transformant efficacement nos recherches en traitements révolutionnaires, nous contribuons à rendre la médecine plus accessible et à ouvrir davantage de possibilités aux patients et davantage d’opportunités à ceux qui en prennent soin. C’est notre approche depuis le premier jour, mais nous savons que nous ne pouvons pas changer le monde des maladies rares à nous seuls. Pour y parvenir, il faut des partenariats solides avec les patients, les partenaires et les parties prenantes tout au long de la chaîne de valeur. jobs.description:
Manufacturing Science and Technology  (MSAT) is part of the Global CMC, Science & Technology Department (GCSAT).
 GCSAT is responsible for optimization and life cycle management of Sobis clinical and commercial manufacturing processes from internal and external network. MSAT ensures compliant, reliable, cost effective and sustainable manufacturing of our products now and in future. The MSAT team holds the senior scientific and technical knowledge for the manufacturing of Sobis clinical and commercial products and is responsible for always keeping the internal and external manufacturing processes in a validated stage.
 Main responsibilities:

• Process owner of DS validation for Sobi products.

• Lead and execute MSAT projects such as manufacturing process and cost improvement as part of LCM.

• Participate in internal activities related to (external) manufacturing such as process changes, major/critical deviations, risk assessments and CAPAs.

• Issue, review and approve applicable internal and external SOP’s and manufacturing instructions.

• Review and supervise set up, execution and documentation of technical studies, qualifications and validations.

• Write and review applicable sections of the APR/PQR.

• Write and review applicable sections in registration files, variations and market expansion.

• Support in sourcing evaluation of new DS contract manufacturers and participation in developing supply and quality agreements.

• Lead the technical part of a product transfer, scale up activities, validations and oversees manufacturing of DS processes at external manufacturers for Sobi projects in clinical and commercial phase.

• Be aware of external biopharmaceutical manufacturing technology advancements, understand and introduce new technologies and how they may be applicable to process innovation, cost or yield improvement

• University education in Chemistry, Biology, Biotechnology, Pharmacy or similar.

• +5 years of experience of development and manufacturing of Drug Substance for clinical and commercial use

• Scientific and technical background of CMC development and manufacturing of Drug Substance.

• Recognized expert in drug substance manufacturing

• Demonstrable experience of working in cross functional team with ability to multi task, prioritize and be an effective decision maker

• Experience of regulatory guidelines, regulatory authorities communication and file documentation

• Fluent in English

How to apply
 We have an ongoing selection process in this recruitment and ask you to send your application as soon as possible. Click apply and include your resume in English.
 Why Join Us?
 Here at Sobi, our mission and culture get us excited to come to work every day, but here are a few more reasons to join our team:

• Emphasis on work/life balance

• Collaborative and team-oriented environment

• Opportunities for professional growth

• Diversity and Inclusion

• Competitive compensation for your work

• Making a positive impact to help ultra-rare disease patients who are in need of life saving treatments
 We are a global company with over 1,900 employees in more than 30 countries and are committed to the societies where we operate. With a deeply skilled management team directing our day-to-day wins, and a Board with a stellar track record, we’re ready to take on the world’s diseases, ailments and adversity. Our people believe they have the power to make a positive impact in others’ lives because that’s exactly what we do here. If you’re seeking a career that taps into your talents in a way that makes the world a better, healthier place, we just may have a job for you.

We know our employees are our most valuable asset, and our culture conveys that. We offer a competitive benefits package, to support the health and happiness of our staff.

jobs.title: QA Analytical Specialist
jobs.description:
About the role
 Global Quality plays a key role in making sure our medicines meet internal standards, regulatory expectations, and the commitments in our registration files. As an independent quality organisation, we bring the expertise to deliver on these commitments—while continuously strengthening our capabilities, developing our people, and evolving our quality system to support the business as we grow.
 As QA Analytical Specialist, you’ll be the quality partner for analytical activities and stability studies for products where Sobi is the MAH. You’ll ensure GMP-compliant methods and data support reliable release and stability testing for both clinical and commercial supply—working closely with internal stakeholders and external partners to keep quality, compliance, and patient impact at the centre of everything we do.
 It is a Hybrid role and can be based in either Stockholm or Basel, reporting to Head of Quality Product Lifecycle & Clinical Supply.

Key Responsibilities

• Coordinator and Quality approver for deviations, CAPA and change controls.

• QA-approver for GMP-related analytical activities, e.g. validation and technology transfer of analytical methods used for in-process control, release and stability studies.

• Performance of quality evaluation of CLOs.

• QA contact for CLOs

• Provide Quality Assurance for stability studies for products where Sobi is the MAH, including approving plans and protocols.

• Perform QA review and approval of extension of expiry date of critical analytical material, including but not limited to reference standards and control samples.

• Perform QA review and approval of product specifications.

• Give support to Global Regulatory Affairs / CMC in analytical quality issues for variations and market expansions.

• Act as a representative of Global Quality and provide QA analytical guidance to support projects in order to ensure compliance with GMP

• Manage Quality Technical Agreements with CLOs.

• Author, review and approve SOPs and related documentation related to the position.

About you
 You’re a quality-minded analytical professional who enjoys working cross-functionally, taking ownership, and bringing structure to complex scientific work. You combine strong GMP understanding with a collaborative mindset, and you’re motivated by the opportunity to help deliver reliable, high-quality medicines to patients who need them most.
 Qualifications

• University degree in Chemistry, Biology, Biotechnology, Pharmaceutical Science, or similar.

• 5+ years’ experience in GMP analytical work within pharma/biotech—covering analytical method development and validation, product specifications, deviation investigations, and change control; ideally in QA supporting QC (or as a QC Coordinator/similar).

• Broad knowledge of analytical chemistry and bioassays, including clear and compliant documentation practices.

• Professional proficiency in English, written and spoken.

• You live the Sobi CARE values: Care, Ambition, Urgency, Ownership and Partnership.

• Ability to work independently, take initiative, and make sound quality decisions.

• Strong communication skills and a collaborative, team-oriented approach.

• A structured mindset with attention to detail and a commitment to continuous improvement.

Here at Sobi we live by our core values: Care, Ambition, Urgency, Ownership and Partnership!

How to apply
 We have an ongoing selection process in this recruitment and ask you to send your application as soon as possible. Click apply and include your resume.
 Why Join Us?
 Here at Sobi, our mission and culture get us excited to come to work every day, but here are a few more reasons to join our team:

• Collaborative and team-oriented environment

• Opportunities for professional growth

• Diversity and Inclusion

• Competitive compensation for your work

• Making a positive impact to help ultra-rare disease patients who are in need of life saving treatments

• Emphasis on work/life balance

Sobi is a global company with over 1,900 employees in more than 30 countries and are committed to the societies where we operate. We are a specialised international biopharmaceutical company transforming the lives of people with rare and debilitating diseases, providing reliable access to innovative medicines in the areas of haematology, immunology, and specialty care. Sobi’s share is listed on Nasdaq Stockholm. More about Sobi at sobi.com and LinkedIn.

We know our employees are our most valuable asset and our culture conveys that. We offer a competitive benefits package, to support the health and happiness of our staff.

Sobi Culture

At Sobi, we refuse to accept the status quo. This is because we have witnessed first-hand the challenges facing those affected by rare diseases and have used this knowledge to shape our business to find new ways of helping them.

As a specialized biopharmaceutical company, we are dedicated to rare diseases. And we see this focus as a strength. By effectively turning our research into ground-breaking treatments, we help make medicine more accessible and open more possibilities for patients and more opportunities for those caring for them. This has been our approach since day one, but we know we can’t change the world of rare diseases on our own. Accomplishing this requires strong partnerships with patients, partners and stakeholders across the entire value chain. Together, we define how our business can create solutions that serve the needs of those affected by rare diseases while facilitating sustainable growth.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Descrizione Sul ruolo Global Quality svolge un ruolo chiave nel garantire che i nostri farmaci soddisfino gli standard interni, le aspettative normative e gli impegni nei nostri file di registrazione. Come organizzazione di qualità indipendente, portiamo l'esperienza a fornire su questi impegni, rafforzando continuamente le nostre capacità, sviluppando il nostro popolo, e evolvendo il nostro sistema di qualità per sostenere l'azienda come cresciamo. Come specialista analitico QA, sarete il partner di qualità per attività analitiche e studi di stabilità per i prodotti dove Sobi è il MAH. Garantirai metodi e test affidabili di rilascio e stabilità di GMP per l'offerta clinica e commerciale, lavorando a stretto contatto con gli stakeholder interni e i partner esterni per mantenere la qualità, la conformità e l'impatto dei pazienti al centro di tutto ciò che facciamo. Si tratta di un ruolo ibrido e può essere basato sia a Stoccolma che a Basilea, segnalando al responsabile del ciclo di vita del prodotto di qualità & alimentazione clinica. Mansioni - Coordinatore e Approvatore di Qualità per deviazioni, CAPA e controlli di cambiamento. - Omologazione QA per le attività analitiche relative al GMP, ad esempio validazione e trasferimento tecnologico di metodi analitici utilizzati per il controllo, il rilascio e gli studi di stabilità del processo. - Prestazioni di valutazione della qualità dei CLO. - Contatto QA per CLOs - Fornire garanzia di qualità per gli studi di stabilità per i prodotti in cui Sobi è il MAH, compreso l'approvazione di piani e protocolli. - Eseguire la revisione del QA e l'approvazione dell'estensione della data di scadenza del materiale analitico critico, compreso ma non limitato a standard di riferimento e campioni di controllo. - Eseguire la revisione QA e l'approvazione delle specifiche del prodotto. - Dare supporto a Global Regulatory Affairs / CMC in problemi di qualità analitica per variazioni e espansioni di mercato. - Agire come rappresentante della Qualità Globale e fornire una guida analitica QA per sostenere i progetti al fine di garantire il rispetto di GMP - Gestire accordi tecnici di qualità con CLO. - Autore, revisione e approvazione delle SOP e relativa documentazione relativa alla posizione. Sei un professionista analitico di qualità che ama lavorare in modo trasversale, prendere la proprietà e portare la struttura a un lavoro scientifico complesso. Unisci forte comprensione GMP con una mentalità collaborativa, e sei motivato dall'opportunità di aiutare a fornire farmaci affidabili e di alta qualità ai pazienti che ne hanno più bisogno. Qualifiche - Laurea universitaria in Chimica, Biologia, Biotecnologia, Scienza Farmaceutica, o simili. - 5+ anni di esperienza nel lavoro analitico GMP all’interno del farmaco/biotecnologia, che copre lo sviluppo e la validazione dei metodi analitici, le specifiche del prodotto, le indagini di deviazione e il controllo dei cambiamenti; idealmente nel QA che supporta QC (o come Coordinatore QC/similare). - Ampia conoscenza della chimica analitica e dei bioassai, comprese le pratiche di documentazione chiare e conformi. - Vivi i valori Sobi CARE: Cura, Ambizione, Urgenza, Proprietà e Partenariato. - Capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente, prendere iniziativa e prendere decisioni di qualità sana. - Forte capacità di comunicazione e un approccio collaborativo e orientato al team. - Una mentalità strutturata con attenzione ai dettagli e impegno al miglioramento continuo. Cosa? Qui a Sobi viviamo i nostri valori fondamentali: Cura, Ambizione, Urgenza, Proprietà e Partenariato! Perché unirsi a noi? Qui a Sobi, la nostra missione e la nostra cultura ci eccitano a lavorare ogni giorno, ma qui ci sono alcune altre ragioni per unirsi al nostro team: - Ambiente collaborativo e di team-oriented - Opportunità per la crescita professionale - Diversità e inclusione - Compenso competitivo per il vostro lavoro - Rendere un impatto positivo per aiutare i pazienti affetti da malattie ultra rare che hanno bisogno di trattamenti di salvataggio - l'enfasi sul lavoro/equilibrio di vita Sobi è una società globale impegnata con oltre 1900 persone. Siamo un'azienda biofarmaceutica internazionale specializzata che trasforma la vita di persone con malattie rare e debilitanti, fornendo un accesso affidabile a farmaci innovativi nelle aree di ematologia, immunologia e cura delle specialità. La quota di Sobi è quotata su Nasdaq Stockholm. Maggiori informazioni su Sobi a sobi.com e LinkedIn. descriptionByLocale.en:
About the role Global Quality plays a key role in making sure our medicines meet internal standards, regulatory expectations, and the commitments in our registration files. As an independent quality organisation, we bring the expertise to deliver on these commitments—while continuously strengthening our capabilities, developing our people, and evolving our quality system to support the business as we grow. As QA Analytical Specialist, you’ll be the quality partner for analytical activities and stability studies for products where Sobi is the MAH. You’ll ensure GMP-compliant methods and data support reliable release and stability testing for both clinical and commercial supply—working closely with internal stakeholders and external partners to keep quality, compliance, and patient impact at the centre of everything we do. It is a Hybrid role and can be based in either Stockholm or Basel, reporting to Head of Quality Product Lifecycle & Clinical Supply.   Key Responsibilities
• Coordinator and Quality approver for deviations, CAPA and change controls.
• QA-approver for GMP-related analytical activities, e.g. validation and technology transfer of analytical methods used for in-process control, release and stability studies.
• Performance of quality evaluation of CLOs.
• QA contact for CLOs
• Provide Quality Assurance for stability studies for products where Sobi is the MAH, including approving plans and protocols.
• Perform QA review and approval of extension of expiry date of critical analytical material, including but not limited to reference standards and control samples.
• Perform QA review and approval of product specifications.
• Give support to Global Regulatory Affairs / CMC in analytical quality issues for variations and market expansions.
• Act as a representative of Global Quality and provide QA analytical guidance to support projects in order to ensure compliance with GMP
• Manage Quality Technical Agreements with CLOs.
• Author, review and approve SOPs and related documentation related to the position. About you You’re a quality-minded analytical professional who enjoys working cross-functionally, taking ownership, and bringing structure to complex scientific work. You combine strong GMP understanding with a collaborative mindset, and you’re motivated by the opportunity to help deliver reliable, high-quality medicines to patients who need them most. Qualifications
• University degree in Chemistry, Biology, Biotechnology, Pharmaceutical Science, or similar.
• 5+ years’ experience in GMP analytical work within pharma/biotech—covering analytical method development and validation, product specifications, deviation investigations, and change control; ideally in QA supporting QC (or as a QC Coordinator/similar).
• Broad knowledge of analytical chemistry and bioassays, including clear and compliant documentation practices.
• Professional proficiency in English, written and spoken.
• You live the Sobi CARE values: Care, Ambition, Urgency, Ownership and Partnership.
• Ability to work independently, take initiative, and make sound quality decisions.
• Strong communication skills and a collaborative, team-oriented approach.
• A structured mindset with attention to detail and a commitment to continuous improvement.   Here at Sobi we live by our core values: Care, Ambition, Urgency, Ownership and Partnership! How to apply We have an ongoing selection process in this recruitment and ask you to send your application as soon as possible. Click apply and include your resume. Why Join Us? Here at Sobi, our mission and culture get us excited to come to work every day, but here are a few more reasons to join our team:
• Collaborative and team-oriented environment
• Opportunities for professional growth
• Diversity and Inclusion
• Competitive compensation for your work
• Making a positive impact to help ultra-rare disease patients who are in need of life saving treatments
• Emphasis on work/life balance   Sobi is a global company with over 1,900 employees in more than 30 countries and are committed to the societies where we operate. We are a specialised international biopharmaceutical company transforming the lives of people with rare and debilitating diseases, providing reliable access to innovative medicines in the areas of haematology, immunology, and specialty care. Sobi’s share is listed on Nasdaq Stockholm. More about Sobi at sobi.com and LinkedIn. We know our employees are our most valuable asset and our culture conveys that. We offer a competitive benefits package, to support the health and happiness of our staff. Sobi Culture At Sobi, we refuse to accept the status quo. This is because we have witnessed first-hand the challenges facing those affected by rare diseases and have used this knowledge to shape our business to find new ways of helping them. As a specialized biopharmaceutical company, we are dedicated to rare diseases. And we see this focus as a strength. By effectively turning our research into ground-breaking treatments, we help make medicine more accessible and open more possibilities for patients and more opportunities for those caring for them. This has been our approach since day one, but we know we can’t change the world of rare diseases on our own. Accomplishing this requires strong partnerships with patients, partners and stakeholders across the entire value chain. Together, we define how our business can create solutions that serve the needs of those affected by rare diseases while facilitating sustainable growth.

Descrizione À propos du rôle de Global Quality joue un rôle clé pour s'assurer que nos médicaments répondent aux normes internes, aux attentes réglementaires et aux engagements dans nos dossiers d'enregistrement. En tant qu'organisation de qualité indépendante, nous apportons l'expertise nécessaire pour respecter ces engagements, tout en renforçant continuellement nos capacités, en développant notre personnel et en développant notre système de qualité pour soutenir l'entreprise en pleine croissance. En tant que spécialiste en analyse de l'AQ, vous serez le partenaire de qualité pour les activités analytiques et les études de stabilité pour les produits où Sobi est le MAH. Vous vous assurerez que les méthodes et les données conformes aux BPF soutiennent des essais fiables de libération et de stabilité pour l'approvisionnement clinique et commercial, en travaillant en étroite collaboration avec les intervenants internes et les partenaires externes pour maintenir la qualité, la conformité et l'impact patient au centre de tout ce que nous faisons. Il s'agit d'un rôle hybride et peut être basé à Stockholm ou Bâle, relevant du responsable du cycle de vie des produits de qualité et de l'approvisionnement clinique. Mansioni - Coordonnatrice et approbatrice de qualité pour les écarts, l'ACAP et les contrôles des changements. - AQ-approver pour les activités d'analyse liées aux BPF, par exemple la validation et le transfert de technologie des méthodes d'analyse utilisées pour les études de contrôle, de libération et de stabilité en cours de fabrication. - Réalisation de l'évaluation de la qualité des CLO. - Personne-ressource de l'AQ pour les ALC - Fournir l'assurance de la qualité pour les études de stabilité des produits où Sobi est le titulaire de l'AMM, y compris l'approbation des plans et des protocoles. - Procéder à l'examen de l'AQ et à l'approbation de la prolongation de la date d'expiration du matériel analytique essentiel, y compris, sans s'y limiter, les normes de référence et les échantillons témoins. - Examiner et approuver les spécifications du produit. - Appuyer les Affaires réglementaires mondiales / CMC dans les questions de qualité analytique pour les variations et l'expansion du marché. - Agir en tant que représentant de la qualité mondiale et fournir des conseils analytiques sur l'AQ pour appuyer les projets afin d'assurer le respect des BPF - Gérer les accords techniques de qualité avec les OPC. - Auteur, révise et approuve les PNE et la documentation connexe relative au poste.
• Requisiti À propos de vous Vous êtes un professionnel analytique de qualité qui aime travailler de manière interfonctionnelle, s'approprier et structurer des travaux scientifiques complexes. Vous combinez une bonne compréhension des BPF avec un état d'esprit collaboratif, et vous êtes motivé par la possibilité d'aider à fournir des médicaments fiables et de haute qualité aux patients qui en ont le plus besoin.
• Qualifications - Diplôme universitaire en chimie, en biologie, en biotechnologie, en sciences pharmaceutiques ou similaires. - 5+ ans d'expérience en travail d'analyse des BPF au sein de la pharmacologie et de la biotechnologie - couvrant la mise au point et la validation de méthodes d'analyse, les spécifications du produit, les enquêtes sur les écarts et le contrôle des changements; idéalement dans l'AQ appuyant le QC (ou comme coordonnateur/similaire du QC). - Connaissance approfondie de la chimie analytique et des essais biologiques, y compris des pratiques de documentation claires et conformes. - Compétence professionnelle en anglais, écrit et parlé. - Capacité de travailler de façon indépendante, de prendre des initiatives et de prendre des décisions judicieuses en matière de qualité. - De solides compétences en communication et une approche collaborative et axée sur l'équipe. - Un état d'esprit structuré avec une attention aux détails et un engagement à l'amélioration continue.
• Cosa offriamo Ici, à Sobi, nous vivons par nos valeurs fondamentales : Soins, Ambition, Urgence, Propriété et Partenariat ! Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? Nous sommes une entreprise biopharmaceutique internationale spécialisée qui transforme la vie des personnes atteintes de maladies rares et débilitantes, fournissant un accès fiable aux médicaments innovants dans les domaines de l'hématologie, de l'immunologie et des soins spécialisés. Sa part est cotée sur Nasdaq Stockholm. Plus d'informations sur Sobi sur sobi.com et LinkedIn. Nous savons que nos employés sont notre atout le plus précieux et que notre culture le démontre.
• Nous offrons un ensemble d'avantages concurrentiels, pour soutenir la santé et le bonheur de notre personnel. Sobi Culture Chez Sobi, nous refusons le statu quo. C'est parce que nous avons été témoins de première main des défis auxquels sont confrontés les personnes touchées par des maladies rares et que nous avons utilisé ces connaissances pour façonner notre entreprise afin de trouver de nouvelles façons de les aider. jobs.title: Strategic Planning Manager Supply Chain
jobs.description:
About the role
 Are you energized by complexity, motivated by purpose, and excited by the opportunity to shape supply planning for a product in a pivotal growth phase? As Strategic Planning Manager for you will play a central role in ensuring robust product availability across Drug Substance, Drug Product and Finished Goods. Working across the full supply chain, you will translate commercial and medical priorities into clear, executable plans, navigate uncertainty with confidence, and help steer key decisions that directly support patients living with rare diseases.
 This role offers broad visibility and impact, spanning strategic long-term planning, tactical decision-making, and day-to-day supply assurance.
 You will join our Global Supply Operations team, report to the Head of Planning, and be based at our Stockholm HQ or Global Hub in Basel.

In this role, you will:

• Own and continuously evolve the integrated end-to-end supply plan across short-, mid- and long-term horizons, balancing commercial and medical demand, inventory strategy and supply capabilities.

• Lead scenario planning and supply risk assessments, translating uncertainty into clear options, recommendations and decision material for governance and senior stakeholders.

• Turn demand signals into capacity, material and inventory requirements, and drive alignment on assumptions and commitments across key planning cycles.

• Shape allocation and supply prioritization proposals when demand exceeds supply, ensuring transparent trade-offs and strong alignment across markets, indications and programs.

• Partner closely with Commercial, Medical, TechOps, Quality, Regulatory, Global Distribution and external partners to create one aligned, executable plan.

• Prepare and present planning insights, risks and mitigation plans in product teams and governance forums, acting as a trusted voice on supply planning and constraints.

• Establish meaningful planning KPIs and continuously improve ways of working, data quality and tools to strengthen planning performance over time.

About you
 You are someone who thrives in a fast-moving, high-growth environment and brings calm, structure and sound judgement when complexity is high. You enjoy working across functions and geographies, influencing without formal authority, and turning ambiguity into clear direction. Just as importantly, you are motivated by meaningful work and excited by the opportunity to help secure supply for patients who rely on innovative treatment options.

To succeed in this role, you will bring:

• A university degree in engineering, supply chain, business, finance or a related field.

• Significant experience in end-to-end supply planning within pharma, biotech or another highly regulated and complex supply chain environment.

• A strong track record of building integrated demand and supply plans, leading scenario planning, and navigating supply constraints and prioritization decisions.

• Experience working cross-functionally with close exposure to Commercial and/or Medical organizations, ideally in launch, access or demand-shaping environments.

• An advanced degree, MBA, or experience in launch planning, indication expansion, partnership supply chains or capacity expansion projects would be an advantage

• Strong end-to-end planning expertise, including S&OP, supply planning, inventory strategy, capacity planning and scenario management.

• The ability to translate complex data into clear insights, business decisions and practical actions.

• Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with confidence presenting to senior forums and driving alignment under pressure.

• Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills, with advanced Excel capabilities and experience with planning or analytics systems such as Kinaxis Maestro or Power BI considered a plus.

• Fluent English, both written and spoken; additional languages are an advantage.

Here at Sobi we live by our core values: Care, Ambition, Urgency, Ownership and Partnership!

How to apply
 We have an ongoing selection process in this recruitment and ask you to send your application as soon as possible. Click apply and include your resume in English.
 Why Join Us?
 Here at Sobi, our mission and culture get us excited to come to work every day, but here are a few more reasons to join our team:

• Collaborative and team-oriented environment

• Opportunities for professional growth

• Diversity and Inclusion

• Competitive compensation for your work

• Making a positive impact to help ultra-rare disease patients who are in need of life saving treatments

• Emphasis on work/life balance

We are a global company with over 1,900 employees in more than 30 countries and are committed to the societies where we operate. With a deeply skilled management team directing our day-to-day wins, and a Board with a stellar track record, we’re ready to take on the world’s diseases, ailments and adversity. Our people believe they have the power to make a positive impact in others’ lives because that’s exactly what we do here. If you’re seeking a career that taps into your talents in a way that makes the world a better, healthier place, we just may have a job for you.

We know our employees are our most valuable asset, and our culture conveys that. We offer a competitive benefits package, to support the health and happiness of our staff.

Sobi Culture

At Sobi, we refuse to accept the status quo. This is because we have witnessed first-hand the challenges facing those affected by rare diseases and have used this knowledge to shape our business to find new ways of helping them.

As a specialized biopharmaceutical company, we are dedicated to rare diseases. And we see this focus as a strength. By effectively turning our research into ground-breaking treatments, we help make medicine more accessible and open up more possibilities for patients and more opportunities for those caring for them. This has been our approach since day one, but we know we can’t change the world of rare diseases on our own. Accomplishing this requires strong partnerships with patients, partners and stakeholders across the entire value chain.
