About the role Are you energized by complexity, motivated by purpose, and excited by the opportunity to shape supply planning for a product in a pivotal growth phase? As Strategic Planning Manager for you will play a central role in ensuring robust product availability across Drug Substance, Drug Product and Finished Goods. Working across the full supply chain, you will translate commercial and medical priorities into clear, executable plans, navigate uncertainty with confidence, and help steer key decisions that directly support patients living with rare diseases. This role offers broad visibility and impact, spanning strategic long-term planning, tactical decision-making, and day-to-day supply assurance. You will join our Global Supply Operations team, report to the Head of Planning, and be based at our Stockholm HQ or Global Hub in Basel.   In this role, you will:
• Own and continuously evolve the integrated end-to-end supply plan across short-, mid- and long-term horizons, balancing commercial and medical demand, inventory strategy and supply capabilities.
• Lead scenario planning and supply risk assessments, translating uncertainty into clear options, recommendations and decision material for governance and senior stakeholders.
• Turn demand signals into capacity, material and inventory requirements, and drive alignment on assumptions and commitments across key planning cycles.
• Shape allocation and supply prioritization proposals when demand exceeds supply, ensuring transparent trade-offs and strong alignment across markets, indications and programs.
• Partner closely with Commercial, Medical, TechOps, Quality, Regulatory, Global Distribution and external partners to create one aligned, executable plan.
• Prepare and present planning insights, risks and mitigation plans in product teams and governance forums, acting as a trusted voice on supply planning and constraints.
• Establish meaningful planning KPIs and continuously improve ways of working, data quality and tools to strengthen planning performance over time. About you You are someone who thrives in a fast-moving, high-growth environment and brings calm, structure and sound judgement when complexity is high. You enjoy working across functions and geographies, influencing without formal authority, and turning ambiguity into clear direction. Just as importantly, you are motivated by meaningful work and excited by the opportunity to help secure supply for patients who rely on innovative treatment options.   To succeed in this role, you will bring:
• A university degree in engineering, supply chain, business, finance or a related field.
• Significant experience in end-to-end supply planning within pharma, biotech or another highly regulated and complex supply chain environment.
• A strong track record of building integrated demand and supply plans, leading scenario planning, and navigating supply constraints and prioritization decisions.
• Experience working cross-functionally with close exposure to Commercial and/or Medical organizations, ideally in launch, access or demand-shaping environments.
• An advanced degree, MBA, or experience in launch planning, indication expansion, partnership supply chains or capacity expansion projects would be an advantage
• Strong end-to-end planning expertise, including S&OP, supply planning, inventory strategy, capacity planning and scenario management.
• The ability to translate complex data into clear insights, business decisions and practical actions.
• Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with confidence presenting to senior forums and driving alignment under pressure.
• Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills, with advanced Excel capabilities and experience with planning or analytics systems such as Kinaxis Maestro or Power BI considered a plus.
• Fluent English, both written and spoken; additional languages are an advantage.   Here at Sobi we live by our core values: Care, Ambition, Urgency, Ownership and Partnership! How to apply We have an ongoing selection process in this recruitment and ask you to send your application as soon as possible. Click apply and include your resume in English.  Why Join Us? Here at Sobi, our mission and culture get us excited to come to work every day, but here are a few more reasons to join our team:
• Collaborative and team-oriented environment
• Opportunities for professional growth
• Diversity and Inclusion
• Competitive compensation for your work
• Making a positive impact to help ultra-rare disease patients who are in need of life saving treatments
• Emphasis on work/life balance We are a global company with over 1,900 employees in more than 30 countries and are committed to the societies where we operate. With a deeply skilled management team directing our day-to-day wins, and a Board with a stellar track record, we’re ready to take on the world’s diseases, ailments and adversity. Our people believe they have the power to make a positive impact in others’ lives because that’s exactly what we do here. If you’re seeking a career that taps into your talents in a way that makes the world a better, healthier place, we just may have a job for you. We know our employees are our most valuable asset, and our culture conveys that. We offer a competitive benefits package, to support the health and happiness of our staff. Sobi Culture At Sobi, we refuse to accept the status quo. This is because we have witnessed first-hand the challenges facing those affected by rare diseases and have used this knowledge to shape our business to find new ways of helping them. As a specialized biopharmaceutical company, we are dedicated to rare diseases. And we see this focus as a strength. By effectively turning our research into ground-breaking treatments, we help make medicine more accessible and open up more possibilities for patients and more opportunities for those caring for them. This has been our approach since day one, but we know we can’t change the world of rare diseases on our own. Accomplishing this requires strong partnerships with patients, partners and stakeholders across the entire value chain. Together, we define how our business can create solutions that serve the needs of those affected by rare diseases while facilitating sustainable growth.

Diese Rolle bietet eine breite Sichtbarkeit und Wirkung, die strategische langfristige Planung, taktische Entscheidungsfindung und tägliche Versorgungssicherheit umfasst. Sie werden sich unserem Global Supply Operations Team anschließen, dem Leiter der Planung berichten und auf unserem Stockholm HQ oder Global Hub in Basel basieren. Descrizione Êtes-vous stimulé par la complexité, motivé par le but, et excité par la possibilité de façonner la planification d'approvisionnement pour un produit dans une phase de croissance pivot? En tant que gestionnaire de la planification stratégique pour vous, vous jouerez un rôle central pour assurer une disponibilité solide des produits dans l'ensemble des substances médicamenteuses, des produits pharmaceutiques et des produits finis. En travaillant sur l'ensemble de la chaîne d'approvisionnement, vous allez traduire les priorités commerciales et médicales en plans clairs et exécutables, naviguer l'incertitude avec confiance et aider à orienter les décisions clés qui soutiennent directement les patients atteints de maladies rares. Ce rôle offre une large visibilité et un impact, couvrant la planification stratégique à long terme, la prise de décisions tactiques et l'assurance de l'approvisionnement quotidien. Vous rejoindrez notre équipe d'opérations d'approvisionnement mondial, ferez rapport au Chef de la planification et serez basé à notre QG de Stockholm ou Global Hub à Bâle. Mansioni - Le plan intégré d'approvisionnement de bout en bout évolue lui-même et en permanence à court, à moyen et à long terme, en conciliant la demande commerciale et médicale, la stratégie d'inventaire et les capacités d'approvisionnement. - La planification des scénarios et l'évaluation des risques liés à l'offre, ce qui traduit l'incertitude en options claires, en recommandations et en documents décisionnels pour la gouvernance et les principaux intervenants. - Transformer les signaux de la demande en besoins en matière de capacité, de matériel et d'inventaire, et orienter l'alignement sur les hypothèses et les engagements pour les principaux cycles de planification. - Former les propositions d'attribution et de hiérarchisation de l'offre lorsque la demande dépasse l'offre, en assurant des compromis transparents et une forte harmonisation entre les marchés, les indications et les programmes. - S'associer étroitement avec des partenaires commerciaux, médicaux, techniques, de qualité, réglementaires, de distribution mondiale et externes pour créer un plan exécutable aligné. - Préparer et présenter des plans de planification, des risques et des plans d'atténuation dans les équipes de produits et les forums de gouvernance, agissant comme une voix de confiance sur la planification de l'offre et les contraintes. - Établir des ICR de planification valables et améliorer continuellement les méthodes de travail, la qualité des données et les outils pour renforcer le rendement de la planification au fil du temps.
• Requisiti - Un diplôme universitaire en ingénierie, chaîne d'approvisionnement, entreprise, finance ou un domaine connexe. - Expérience importante dans la planification d'approvisionnement de bout en bout au sein de la pharmacologie, de la biotechnologie ou d'un autre environnement hautement réglementé et complexe de la chaîne d'approvisionnement. - Une solide expérience en matière d'élaboration de plans intégrés de la demande et de l'offre, de planification des scénarios, de navigation des contraintes de l'offre et de choix des priorités. - Expérience de travail interfonctionnel avec une exposition étroite aux organisations commerciales et/ou médicales, idéalement dans les environnements de lancement, d'accès ou de formation de la demande. - Un diplôme avancé, un MBA ou une expérience dans la planification de lancement, l'expansion des indications, les chaînes d'approvisionnement de partenariat ou les projets d'expansion des capacités serait un avantage. - Une solide expertise en planification de bout en bout, y compris en S-P, en planification des approvisionnements, en stratégie d'inventaire, en planification des capacités et en gestion des scénarios. - La capacité de traduire des données complexes en idées claires, décisions d'affaires et actions pratiques. - Excellente capacité de gestion et de communication des parties prenantes, avec confiance dans les forums de haut niveau et conduite de l'alignement sous pression. - Fortes compétences analytiques et structurées en résolution de problèmes, avec des capacités Excel avancées et une expérience avec des systèmes de planification ou d'analyse tels que Kinaxis Maestro ou Power BI considéré comme un plus. - L'anglais, à la fois écrit et parlé; d'autres langues sont un avantage.
• Cosa offriamo - Environnement collaboratif et axé sur l'équipe - Possibilités de croissance professionnelle - Diversité et inclusion - Compensation compétitive pour votre travail - Faire un impact positif pour aider les patients atteints de maladies ultra-rares qui ont besoin de traitements vitaux - Mettre l ' accent sur l ' équilibre entre vie professionnelle et vie privée Culture sobi Chez Sobi, nous refusons le statu quo. C'est parce que nous avons été témoins de première main des défis auxquels sont confrontés les personnes touchées par des maladies rares et que nous avons utilisé ces connaissances pour façonner notre entreprise afin de trouver de nouvelles façons de les aider. En tant qu'entreprise biopharmaceutique spécialisée, nous sommes dédiés aux maladies rares. Et nous voyons cet accent comme une force. En transformant efficacement nos recherches en traitements révolutionnaires, nous aidons à rendre la médecine plus accessible et à ouvrir davantage de possibilités aux patients et à ceux qui s'en occupent. C'est notre approche depuis le premier jour, mais nous savons que nous ne pouvons pas changer le monde des maladies rares nous-mêmes. Pour y parvenir, il faut établir des partenariats solides avec les patients, les partenaires et les intervenants dans toute la chaîne de valeur. Ensemble, nous définissons comment notre entreprise peut créer des solutions qui répondent aux besoins des personnes touchées par des maladies rares tout en facilitant une croissance durable. Contatto Nous avons un processus de sélection continu dans ce recrutement et vous demandons d'envoyer votre candidature dès que possible. Cliquez sur appliquer et inclure votre CV en anglais.

jobs.description:
About the role
 As the Director of Information Security Governance & Compliance, you will play a key leadership role in ensuring that Sobi’s information security framework is robust, effective and fit for a highly regulated environment. You will lead governance and compliance activities across Sobi and our external partners, drive audits and control reviews, maintain a strong and up-to-date ISMS, and oversee CAPA and continuous improvement initiatives. In this role, you will work closely with the CISO, Quality and key stakeholders across the business to make sure our policies, processes and responsibilities are clear, aligned and continuously improving.
 You will join our Global Information Security team, report to the CISO, and be based at our Stockholm HQ or Global Hub in Basel. This is a hybrid role with the opportunity to work in an international setting where your expertise will have visible impact across the organisation.

Your impact will include:

• Lead and evolve Sobi’s information security governance framework and ISMS, including policies, standards and procedures.

• Ensure alignment with key regulatory and industry frameworks such as NIS2, GDPR and ISO 27001.

• Plan and lead internal and external audits, as well as compliance reviews across the organisation and third parties.

• Oversee incident follow-up, root cause analysis, CAPA activities and risk mitigation tracking to closure.

• Establish meaningful compliance and risk metrics, continuous improvement processes and provide clear reporting to support decision-making.

• Partner closely with the CISO, Quality, business stakeholders, auditors and external partners to build a strong culture of accountability and security awareness.

About you
 You are a confident and pragmatic information security leader who enjoys combining governance, compliance and continuous improvement in a way that creates real business value. You are comfortable navigating a complex, regulated environment and know how to translate frameworks and requirements into practical ways of working. Just as importantly, you build trust across functions and communicate with clarity—whether you are partnering with senior stakeholders, supporting audits, or driving follow-up actions with the wider organisation. You bring a structured and proactive mindset, a strong sense of ownership, and a genuine interest in building a security culture that is both effective and sustainable.
 What you bring

• Strong experience in information security governance, risk and compliance, ideally in a global or highly regulated environment.

• Solid knowledge of relevant frameworks and regulations such as NIS2, GDPR, ISO 27001 and ideally GxP/ALCOA+ or GAMP.

• A proven ability to lead audits, compliance programmes and continuous improvement initiatives.

• Experience working with third-party assessments, supplier compliance or external oversight.

• Strong analytical skills with the ability to prioritise, follow through and create structure in complex topics.

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to influence across functions and levels.

Here at Sobi we live by our core values: Care, Ambition, Urgency, Ownership and Partnership!

How to apply
 We have an ongoing selection process in this recruitment and ask you to send your application as soon as possible. Click apply and include your resume.
 Why Join Us?
 Here at Sobi, our mission and culture get us excited to come to work every day, but here are a few more reasons to join our team:

• Collaborative and team-oriented environment

• Opportunities for professional growth

• Diversity and Inclusion

• Competitive compensation for your work

• Making a positive impact to help ultra-rare disease patients who are in need of life saving treatments

• Emphasis on work/life balance

Sobi is a global company with over 1,900 employees in more than 30 countries and are committed to the societies where we operate. We are a specialised international biopharmaceutical company transforming the lives of people with rare and debilitating diseases, providing reliable access to innovative medicines in the areas of haematology, immunology, and specialty care. Sobi’s share is listed on Nasdaq Stockholm. More about Sobi at sobi.com and LinkedIn.

We know our employees are our most valuable asset and our culture conveys that. We offer a competitive benefits package, to support the health and happiness of our staff.

Sobi Culture

At Sobi, we refuse to accept the status quo. This is because we have witnessed first-hand the challenges facing those affected by rare diseases and have used this knowledge to shape our business to find new ways of helping them.

As a specialized biopharmaceutical company, we are dedicated to rare diseases. And we see this focus as a strength. By effectively turning our research into ground-breaking treatments, we help make medicine more accessible and open more possibilities for patients and more opportunities for those caring for them. This has been our approach since day one, but we know we can’t change the world of rare diseases on our own. Accomplishing this requires strong partnerships with patients, partners and stakeholders across the entire value chain. Together, we define how our business can create solutions that serve the needs of those affected by rare diseases while facilitating sustainable growth.

• Pianificare e condurre audit interni ed esterni, nonché le recensioni di conformità in tutta l'organizzazione e terzi.
• Controllare il follow-up degli incidenti, l'analisi delle cause, le attività CAPA e il monitoraggio della mitigazione dei rischi per la chiusura.
• Stabilire metriche di conformità e di rischio significative, processi di miglioramento continuo e fornire una chiara segnalazione per sostenere il processo decisionale.
• Collaborare a stretto contatto con il CISO, la Qualità, gli stakeholder aziendali, i revisori e i partner esterni per costruire una forte cultura della responsabilità e della consapevolezza della sicurezza. Su di te Sei un leader di sicurezza dell'informazione sicuro e pragmatico che si diverte a combinare governance, conformità e miglioramento continuo in un modo che crea un reale valore aziendale. Sei comodo navigare in un ambiente complesso e regolamentato e sapere come tradurre quadri e requisiti in modi pratici di lavoro. Proprio come importante, si costruisce la fiducia tra le funzioni e comunicare con chiarezza - sia che si stia collaborando con gli stakeholder senior, sostenere gli audit, o guidare azioni di follow-up con l'organizzazione più ampia. Porti una mentalità strutturata e proattiva, un forte senso di proprietà, e un autentico interesse a costruire una cultura di sicurezza che sia efficace e sostenibile. Cosa porti
• Una forte esperienza nella governance della sicurezza delle informazioni, nel rischio e nella conformità, idealmente in un ambiente globale o altamente regolamentato.
• Una solida conoscenza dei quadri e dei regolamenti rilevanti come NIS2, GDPR, ISO 27001 e idealmente GxP/ALCOA+ o GAMP.
• Una comprovata capacità di condurre audit, programmi di conformità e iniziative di miglioramento continuo.
• Esperienza di lavoro con valutazioni di terze parti, conformità del fornitore o supervisione esterna.
• Forte capacità analitiche con la capacità di priorità, seguire e creare la struttura in argomenti complessi.
• Eccellente capacità di comunicazione e gestione degli stakeholder, con la fiducia di influenzare le funzioni e i livelli. Qui a Sobi viviamo i nostri valori fondamentali: Cura, Ambizione, Urgenza, Proprietà e Partenariato! Come applicare Abbiamo un processo di selezione in corso in questo reclutamento e vi chiediamo di inviare la vostra domanda il prima possibile. Fare clic su applicare e includere il tuo curriculum. Perché unirsi a noi? Qui a Sobi, la nostra missione e la nostra cultura ci eccitano a venire al lavoro ogni giorno, ma qui ci sono alcune altre ragioni per unirsi al nostro team:
• Ambiente collaborativo e orientato al team
• Opportunità di crescita professionale
• Diversità e inclusione
• Compensazione competitiva per il vostro lavoro
• Fare un impatto positivo per aiutare i pazienti con malattie ultra rare che hanno bisogno di trattamenti di salvataggio
• enfasi sull'equilibrio del lavoro/vita Sobi è una società globale con oltre 1.900 dipendenti in oltre 30 paesi e si impegnano nelle società in cui operiamo. Siamo un'azienda biofarmaceutica internazionale specializzata che trasforma la vita di persone con malattie rare e debilitanti, fornendo un accesso affidabile a farmaci innovativi nelle aree di ematologia, immunologia e cura delle specialità. La quota di Sobi è elencata su Nasdaq Stockholm. Maggiori informazioni su Sobi a sobi.com e LinkedIn. Sappiamo che i nostri dipendenti sono il nostro bene più prezioso e la nostra cultura lo trasmette. Offriamo un pacchetto di benefici competitivi, per sostenere la salute e la felicità del nostro personale. Sobi Cultura A Sobi, ci rifiutiamo di accettare lo status quo. Questo perché abbiamo assistito in prima persona alle sfide che le persone colpite da malattie rare e abbiamo usato questa conoscenza per plasmare la nostra attività per trovare nuovi modi di aiutarli. Come azienda biofarmaceutica specializzata, siamo dedicati a malattie rare. E vediamo questo obiettivo come una forza. Trasformando efficacemente la nostra ricerca in trattamenti innovativi, aiutiamo a rendere la medicina più accessibile e aprire più possibilità per i pazienti e più opportunità per coloro che li curano. Questo è stato il nostro approccio dal primo giorno, ma sappiamo che non possiamo cambiare il mondo di malattie rare da soli. L'integrazione richiede forti partnership con pazienti, partner e stakeholder in tutta la catena del valore. Insieme, definiamo come il nostro business può creare soluzioni che servono le esigenze di coloro che sono colpiti da malattie rare, facilitando la crescita sostenibile.
descriptionByLocale.en:
About the role As the Director of Information Security Governance & Compliance, you will play a key leadership role in ensuring that Sobi’s information security framework is robust, effective and fit for a highly regulated environment. You will lead governance and compliance activities across Sobi and our external partners, drive audits and control reviews, maintain a strong and up-to-date ISMS, and oversee CAPA and continuous improvement initiatives. In this role, you will work closely with the CISO, Quality and key stakeholders across the business to make sure our policies, processes and responsibilities are clear, aligned and continuously improving. You will join our Global Information Security team, report to the CISO, and be based at our Stockholm HQ or Global Hub in Basel. This is a hybrid role with the opportunity to work in an international setting where your expertise will have visible impact across the organisation.   Your impact will include:
• Lead and evolve Sobi’s information security governance framework and ISMS, including policies, standards and procedures.
• Ensure alignment with key regulatory and industry frameworks such as NIS2, GDPR and ISO 27001.
• Plan and lead internal and external audits, as well as compliance reviews across the organisation and third parties.
• Oversee incident follow-up, root cause analysis, CAPA activities and risk mitigation tracking to closure.
• Establish meaningful compliance and risk metrics, continuous improvement processes and provide clear reporting to support decision-making.
• Partner closely with the CISO, Quality, business stakeholders, auditors and external partners to build a strong culture of accountability and security awareness. About you You are a confident and pragmatic information security leader who enjoys combining governance, compliance and continuous improvement in a way that creates real business value. You are comfortable navigating a complex, regulated environment and know how to translate frameworks and requirements into practical ways of working. Just as importantly, you build trust across functions and communicate with clarity—whether you are partnering with senior stakeholders, supporting audits, or driving follow-up actions with the wider organisation. You bring a structured and proactive mindset, a strong sense of ownership, and a genuine interest in building a security culture that is both effective and sustainable. What you bring
• Strong experience in information security governance, risk and compliance, ideally in a global or highly regulated environment.
• Solid knowledge of relevant frameworks and regulations such as NIS2, GDPR, ISO 27001 and ideally GxP/ALCOA+ or GAMP.
• A proven ability to lead audits, compliance programmes and continuous improvement initiatives.
• Experience working with third-party assessments, supplier compliance or external oversight.
• Strong analytical skills with the ability to prioritise, follow through and create structure in complex topics.
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to influence across functions and levels.   Here at Sobi we live by our core values: Care, Ambition, Urgency, Ownership and Partnership! How to apply We have an ongoing selection process in this recruitment and ask you to send your application as soon as possible. Click apply and include your resume. Why Join Us? Here at Sobi, our mission and culture get us excited to come to work every day, but here are a few more reasons to join our team:
• Collaborative and team-oriented environment
• Opportunities for professional growth
• Diversity and Inclusion
• Competitive compensation for your work
• Making a positive impact to help ultra-rare disease patients who are in need of life saving treatments
• Emphasis on work/life balance   Sobi is a global company with over 1,900 employees in more than 30 countries and are committed to the societies where we operate. We are a specialised international biopharmaceutical company transforming the lives of people with rare and debilitating diseases, providing reliable access to innovative medicines in the areas of haematology, immunology, and specialty care. Sobi’s share is listed on Nasdaq Stockholm. More about Sobi at sobi.com and LinkedIn. We know our employees are our most valuable asset and our culture conveys that. We offer a competitive benefits package, to support the health and happiness of our staff. Sobi Culture At Sobi, we refuse to accept the status quo. This is because we have witnessed first-hand the challenges facing those affected by rare diseases and have used this knowledge to shape our business to find new ways of helping them. As a specialized biopharmaceutical company, we are dedicated to rare diseases. And we see this focus as a strength. By effectively turning our research into ground-breaking treatments, we help make medicine more accessible and open more possibilities for patients and more opportunities for those caring for them. This has been our approach since day one, but we know we can’t change the world of rare diseases on our own. Accomplishing this requires strong partnerships with patients, partners and stakeholders across the entire value chain. Together, we define how our business can create solutions that serve the needs of those affected by rare diseases while facilitating sustainable growth.

Sur le rôle En tant que directeur de la gouvernance et de la conformité en matière de sécurité de l'information, vous jouerez un rôle de leadership clé pour assurer que le cadre de sécurité de l'information de Sobi est solide, efficace et adapté à un environnement hautement réglementé. Vous dirigerez des activités de gouvernance et de conformité à l'échelle de Sobi et de nos partenaires externes, dirigerez des vérifications et des examens de contrôle, maintiendrez un SGSI solide et à jour et superviserez les initiatives d'amélioration continue de l'ACAP. Dans ce rôle, vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec l'ISOC, la Qualité et les principaux intervenants de l'entreprise pour vous assurer que nos politiques, processus et responsabilités sont clairs, harmonisés et continuellement améliorés. Vous rejoindrez notre équipe de la sécurité de l'information mondiale, vous ferez rapport au CISO et serez basé à notre QG de Stockholm ou Global Hub à Bâle. C'est un rôle hybride avec la possibilité de travailler dans un cadre international où votre expertise aura un impact visible dans l'ensemble de l'organisation. Votre impact comprendra :
• Diriger et développer le cadre de gouvernance de la sécurité de l'information et le SIGS, y compris les politiques, les normes et les procédures.
• Assurer l'alignement sur les cadres réglementaires et industriels clés tels que NIS2, RGPD et ISO 27001.

• Établir des indicateurs de conformité et de risque significatifs, des processus d'amélioration continue et fournir des rapports clairs pour appuyer la prise de décisions.
• Collaborer étroitement avec l'ISOC, la qualité, les acteurs du secteur, les auditeurs et les partenaires externes afin d'instaurer une solide culture de responsabilité et de sensibilisation à la sécurité. Sur toi Vous êtes un leader confiant et pragmatique de la sécurité de l'information qui aime combiner gouvernance, conformité et amélioration continue d'une manière qui crée une réelle valeur commerciale. Vous êtes à l'aise de naviguer dans un environnement complexe et réglementé et de savoir traduire les cadres et les exigences en méthodes de travail pratiques. Tout aussi important, vous créez la confiance entre les fonctions et communiquez avec clarté, que vous soyez en partenariat avec des parties prenantes de haut niveau, en soutenant les audits ou en conduisant des actions de suivi avec l'ensemble de l'organisation. Vous apportez un état d'esprit structuré et proactif, un fort sentiment d'appropriation, et un véritable intérêt à construire une culture de sécurité à la fois efficace et durable. • Forte expérience en matière de gouvernance, de risques et de conformité en matière de sécurité de l'information, idéalement dans un environnement mondial ou fortement réglementé.
• Connaissance approfondie des cadres et règlements pertinents tels que NIS2, RGPD, ISO 27001 et idéalement GxP/ALCOA+ ou GAMP.
• Capacité avérée de diriger des audits, des programmes de conformité et des initiatives d'amélioration continue.
• Expérience en matière d'évaluations par des tiers, de conformité des fournisseurs ou de contrôle externe.
• De solides compétences analytiques avec la capacité de prioriser, de suivre et de structurer des sujets complexes.
• Excellentes compétences en communication et gestion des parties prenantes, avec la confiance nécessaire pour influencer les fonctions et les niveaux. Ici, à Sobi, nous vivons par nos valeurs fondamentales : Soins, Ambition, Urgence, Propriété et Partenariat ! • Mettre l'accent sur l'équilibre entre vie professionnelle et vie privée Sobi est une entreprise mondiale qui compte plus de 1 900 employés dans plus de 30 pays et qui est engagée dans les sociétés où nous opérons. Nous sommes une société biopharmaceutique internationale spécialisée qui transforme la vie des personnes atteintes de maladies rares et débilitantes, fournissant un accès fiable aux médicaments innovants dans les domaines de l'hématologie, de l'immunologie et des soins spécialisés. Sa part est cotée sur Nasdaq Stockholm. En savoir plus sur Sobi sur sobi.com et LinkedIn. Nous savons que nos employés sont notre atout le plus précieux et notre culture le démontre. En tant qu'entreprise biopharmaceutique spécialisée, nous sommes dédiés aux maladies rares. Et nous voyons cet accent comme une force. jobs.description:
The Medicine Development Leader (MDL) has the overall accountability for developing, driving and representing the clinical development strategy for the nephrology program within the Core Asset Team (CAT), including benefit/risk evaluation, pharmacovigilance (PV) and safety. The MDL leads the Medicine Development Team (MDT) and assures, in close collaboration with the TA head, the appropriate communication flow between the CAT, the MDT and other associated teams (e.g. the Study Team).
 Key Responsibilities

• Drives the clinical development strategy for the assigned compound(s) across the medicine lifecycle, from proof of concept to successful global regulatory approval(s)/market access for multiple treatment indications.

• Provides clinical and scientific expertise to set and execute the asset strategy and optimize project success.

• Works with functional members, TA head and CAT Leaders to develop Integrated Project Plans (IPP) documents.

• Identifies risks for the program with other functions and develops mitigation strategies to address them.

• Presents the nephrology clinical program to internal (including the CEO and the Executive Committee of the Organisation) and external stakeholders (Health Authorities, Steering Committees, Independent Data Monitoring Committees, and Patient Organisations etc), engages when necessary with Key Opinion Leaders across geographies.

• Is a core member of the benefit risk team (BRT), of regulatory submission teams and of the labeling working group.

• Ensures endorsement of clinical development plans and study documents by Sobi governance bodies (e.g. Sobi Evidence Generation Board, Study Document Review Forum).

• Leads in a matrix the clinical scientists and the Medicine Development Team (consists of representatives from Medical Affairs, Clinical Science, Regulatory, Safety/PV, non-clinical/PK, Biostatistics/Data management, Clinical Program Management, Heath Economics and Outcome Research, RWE, Program Management), providing strategic guidance and being the ultimate accountable for:

• Clinical trial design (clinical study synopsis and protocol development), planning (e.g. sites and countries selection), execution (e.g.medical monitoring, resolution of safety issues; interpretation of statistical analyses) and internal and external communication of study results

• Creation of clinical components of key documents (Clinical Development Plans, Clinical Study Protocols, Investigator’s Brochures, Clinical Study Reports, regulatory documents including maintenance of product licenses, Clinical Modules of registration dossiers, Briefing Books for interactions with Health Authorities) with high quality and consistency with the Integrated Project Plan and Target Product Profile.

• Provision of required input on clinical efficacy, safety, dosing/administration, mechanism of action, etc for the Target Product Profile (TPP)

• Support to registration and market access (Core Data Sheet, Development Safety Update Report, Periodic Safety Update Report, clinical benefit-risk assessment) o Collaboration with Regulatory team to determine international submission strategy

• Medical degree with 10+ years of relevant clinical experience in academic and/or pharmaceutical Global Research & Development roles

• Solid track record in drug development programmes, preferably within nephrology

• Extensive knowledge of clinical trial methodology, global regulatory requirements, and experience in designing and executing clinical studies

• Advanced knowledge of clinical trial operational aspects, including budget and timeline management

• Demonstrated ability to build and execute strategic and tactical plans

• Experience engaging with key internal and external stakeholders

• Specialty in relevant therapeutic area with at least 5 years clinical experience treating patients and successful interactions with major Health Authorities leading to drug approvals

• Strong leadership skills with demonstrated capability to lead cross-functional teams in a matrix environment

• Ability to coach, mentor, and communicate effectively with all audiences internally and externally

• Excellent organisational skills with self-motivated drive to implement best practices

• Demonstrated ability to evaluate and analyse medical and scientific literature

• Fluent written and verbal communication in English

• Alignment with Sobi's core values: Care, Ambition, Urgency, Ownership, and Partnership

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Il Medicine Development Leader (MDL) ha la responsabilità generale di sviluppare, guidare e rappresentare la strategia di sviluppo clinico per il programma nefrologico all'interno del Core Asset Team (CAT), inclusa la valutazione del rapporto beneficio/rischio, la farmacovigilanza (PV) e la sicurezza. L'MDL guida il Medicine Development Team (MDT) e assicura, in stretta collaborazione con il responsabile dell'AT, il flusso di comunicazione appropriato tra CAT, MDT e altri team associati (ad esempio il team di studio). Responsabilità chiave
• Guida la strategia di sviluppo clinico per i composti assegnati attraverso l'intero ciclo di vita del farmaco, dalla prova di concetto all'approvazione normativa globale/accesso al mercato per molteplici indicazioni terapeutiche.
• Fornisce competenze cliniche e scientifiche per impostare ed eseguire la strategia patrimoniale e ottimizzare il successo del progetto.
• Collabora con i membri funzionali, il responsabile AT e i leader CAT per sviluppare documenti di piani di progetto integrati (IPP).
• Identifica i rischi per il programma con altre funzioni e sviluppa strategie di mitigazione per affrontarli.
• Presenta il programma clinico nefrologico alle parti interessate interne (incluso l'amministratore delegato e il comitato esecutivo dell'organizzazione) ed esterne (autorità sanitarie, comitati direttivi, comitati indipendenti di monitoraggio dei dati e organizzazioni di pazienti, ecc.), interagisce, se necessario, con i principali opinion leader in tutte le aree geografiche.
• È un membro fondamentale del team beneficio-rischio (BRT), dei team di presentazione delle normative e del gruppo di lavoro sull'etichettatura.
• Garantisce l'approvazione dei piani di sviluppo clinico e dei documenti di studio da parte degli organi di governo di Sobi (ad esempio Sobi Evidence Generation Board, Study Document Review Forum).

descriptionByLocale.en:
The Medicine Development Leader (MDL) has the overall accountability for developing, driving and representing the clinical development strategy for the nephrology program within the Core Asset Team (CAT), including benefit/risk evaluation, pharmacovigilance (PV) and safety. The MDL leads the Medicine Development Team (MDT) and assures, in close collaboration with the TA head, the appropriate communication flow between the CAT, the MDT and other associated teams (e.g. the Study Team). Key Responsibilities
• Drives the clinical development strategy for the assigned compound(s) across the medicine lifecycle, from proof of concept to successful global regulatory approval(s)/market access for multiple treatment indications.
• Provides clinical and scientific expertise to set and execute the asset strategy and optimize project success.
• Works with functional members, TA head and CAT Leaders to develop Integrated Project Plans (IPP) documents.
• Identifies risks for the program with other functions and develops mitigation strategies to address them.
• Presents the nephrology clinical program to internal (including the CEO and the Executive Committee of the Organisation) and external stakeholders (Health Authorities, Steering Committees, Independent Data Monitoring Committees, and Patient Organisations etc), engages when necessary with Key Opinion Leaders across geographies.
• Is a core member of the benefit risk team (BRT), of regulatory submission teams and of the labeling working group.
• Ensures endorsement of clinical development plans and study documents by Sobi governance bodies (e.g. Sobi Evidence Generation Board, Study Document Review Forum).
• Leads in a matrix the clinical scientists and the Medicine Development Team (consists of representatives from Medical Affairs, Clinical Science, Regulatory, Safety/PV, non-clinical/PK, Biostatistics/Data management, Clinical Program Management, Heath Economics and Outcome Research, RWE, Program Management), providing strategic guidance and being the ultimate accountable for:
• Clinical trial design (clinical study synopsis and protocol development), planning (e.g. sites and countries selection), execution (e.g.medical monitoring, resolution of safety issues; interpretation of statistical analyses) and internal and external communication of study results
• Creation of clinical components of key documents (Clinical Development Plans, Clinical Study Protocols, Investigator’s Brochures, Clinical Study Reports, regulatory documents including maintenance of product licenses, Clinical Modules of registration dossiers, Briefing Books for interactions with Health Authorities) with high quality and consistency with the Integrated Project Plan and Target Product Profile.
• Provision of required input on clinical efficacy, safety, dosing/administration, mechanism of action, etc for the Target Product Profile (TPP)
• Support to registration and market access (Core Data Sheet, Development Safety Update Report, Periodic Safety Update Report, clinical benefit-risk assessment) o Collaboration with Regulatory team to determine international submission strategy
• Medical degree with 10+ years of relevant clinical experience in academic and/or pharmaceutical Global Research & Development roles
• Solid track record in drug development programmes, preferably within nephrology
• Extensive knowledge of clinical trial methodology, global regulatory requirements, and experience in designing and executing clinical studies
• Advanced knowledge of clinical trial operational aspects, including budget and timeline management
• Demonstrated ability to build and execute strategic and tactical plans
• Experience engaging with key internal and external stakeholders
• Specialty in relevant therapeutic area with at least 5 years clinical experience treating patients and successful interactions with major Health Authorities leading to drug approvals
• Strong leadership skills with demonstrated capability to lead cross-functional teams in a matrix environment
• Ability to coach, mentor, and communicate effectively with all audiences internally and externally
• Excellent organisational skills with self-motivated drive to implement best practices
• Demonstrated ability to evaluate and analyse medical and scientific literature
• Fluent written and verbal communication in English
• Alignment with Sobi's core values: Care, Ambition, Urgency, Ownership, and Partnership All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

• Diplôme en médecine avec plus de 10 ans d'expérience clinique pertinente dans des rôles de recherche et de développement universitaires et/ou pharmaceutiques mondiaux
• Solide expérience dans les programmes de développement de médicaments, de préférence en néphrologie
• Connaissance approfondie du domaine clinique méthodologie d'essai, exigences réglementaires mondiales et expérience dans la conception et l'exécution d'études cliniques
• Connaissance avancée des aspects opérationnels des essais cliniques, y compris la gestion du budget et des délais

• Expérience de l'engagement avec des parties prenantes internes et externes clés
• Spécialité dans un domaine thérapeutique pertinent avec au moins 5 ans d'expérience clinique dans le traitement de patients et des interactions réussies avec les principales autorités sanitaires menant à l'approbation de médicaments

jobs.title: Global Director Medical Affairs
jobs.description:
The Director Global Medical Affairs will function as medical lead for dedicated projects driving the launch of Key Brand in Nephrology. This role focuses on building and executing the medical plan for launch activities and supporting cross-functional launch preparation ex-USA, while adhering to the highest scientific and ethical standards.
 Key Responsibilities

• Lead medical strategy and serve as primary point of contact for the cross-functional global brand team

• Act as subject matter expert with deep knowledge of the therapeutic indication and relevant clinical data

• Build and execute global medical communication and tactical plans in collaboration with the medical team

• Manage and strengthen relationships with global key opinion leaders (KOLs)

• Develop and disseminate scientific communications, including support for the publication plan

• Provide scientific and medical input to materials developed by commercial, HEOR, Access, and patient engagement teams

• Create training materials and deliver internal and external scientific education

• Act as trusted representative of Sobi in interactions with external collaborators, stakeholders, and partners

• PhD or medical degree (MD) required

• 5+ years of experience in a global medical affairs role, preferably within the rare disease space

• Experience and ability to effectively engage and build relationships with key external stakeholders

• Demonstrated success in developing and executing strategic and tactical medical plans

• Strong history of delivering key medical affairs outputs and initiatives

• Expertise in evaluating and analyzing medical/scientific literature with precision and accuracy

• Exceptional presentation skills and the ability to communicate complex scientific concepts effectively to diverse audiences

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English

Please note:

As this role carries global responsibilities and can be based across Europe, it is published in several countries. You only need to submit one application — there is no need to apply separately to each posting.

jobs.description:
Role & Function
 The position plays a key role in evaluating, prioritizing, and implementing business development transactions across Sobi.
 This individual will support cross-functional projects and transactions within Business Development both globally and regionally. This role will have both due diligence and alliance management focus, while also providing project management support. Additional responsibilities include leading regional level business development transactions as needed.
 This individual will report directly into the VP, Business Development and Alliance Management based in the USA but will support transaction strategies set by Sobi globally.
 This role will be remote.
 Key Responsibilities

• Liase with Strategy & Corporate Development team members to coordinate due diligence activities following initial evaluation and through all business development discussions

• Lead and own global cross-functional due diligence processes for in-licensing, out-licensing, distribution, and M&A opportunities; coordinate all internal and external resources; establish key value-drivers for business case and contracting efforts; manage the daily dialogue with all internal and external stakeholders

• Establish and maintain internal and external due diligence database activities on assigned projects

• Support agenda development, meeting management, and content support for business development lead

• Lead effort to build and update company capabilities presentations and executive presentation requirements as needed

• Ability to be strategic and prioritize key projects to deliver with optimal impact; Strong interpersonal skills with ability to lead, influence, and manage cross-functional projects and teams with multiple diverse stakeholders, including senior leadership

• Strong strategic and analytical skills with the capability to appropriately define, frame, and summarize issues, questions, and data; to perform accurate risk assessment and analysis; and to think creatively about different ways to analyze data and information

• Ability to negotiate internally with stakeholders at all levels as well as with external resources and counterparts

• Ability to establish logical flow and key points to realize objectives with excellent verbal and written presentation skills

• Ability to be a thought partner to teams across the business

• Ability to handle confidential information and data with the utmost care and demonstration of highest ethical standards

• Domestic and international travel up to 20%
 Personal Attributes
 Team-oriented, eagerness to learn and work with a wide variety of people and backgrounds, someone who can influence, ability to stay focused but balanced across multiple projects comfort with ambiguity, driven by organization and attention to detail, someone with breadth of functional and business knowledge.

• A Bachelor’s degree or equivalent. MBA or related advanced degree preferred.

• Minimum of 5 – 7 years of pharmaceutical/medical industry experience and/or highly related experience in consulting, investment banking, or private equity investing

• Due Diligence expertise, experience, and process knowledge

• Negotiation experience

• Alliance Management experience

• Strong project management skills and understanding of key project management tools utilized

• Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Microsoft PowerPoint and Project Management tools (e.g. Smartsheet) required

Compensation and Total Rewards at Sobi
 At Sobi, we are dedicated to providing our employees with a comprehensive and industry-competitive total rewards package. Our compensation philosophy is designed to recognize and reward talent, ensuring that your contributions are valued and reflected in your overall rewards.
 Your total compensation at Sobi goes beyond just your base salary and annual bonus. It also includes a robust suite of benefits, such as:

• A  competitive 401(k) match  to support your financial future.

• Tuition and wellness reimbursements  to invest in your personal and professional growth.

• A  comprehensive medical, dental, and vision package  to prioritize your health and well-being.

• Additional recognition awards  to celebrate your achievements.
 The base salary range for this role is  XXX – XXX . Each individual offer will be determined based on several factors, including your experience, qualifications, and location. Additionally, this role is eligible for both short-term and long-term bonuses, as outlined in the plan details.
 All Sobi employees need to demonstrate behaviors in line with Sobi's core values: Care, Ambition, Urgency, Ownership and Partnership. Are you ready to be on the Sobi team? Come join a culture that empowers every person to be the person that makes a difference for rare disease.
 Why Join Us?

We are a global company with over 1,900 employees in more than 30 countries and are committed to the societies where we operate. With a deeply skilled management team directing our day-to-day wins, and a Board with a stellar track record, we’re ready to take on the world’s diseases, ailments and adversity. Our people believe they have the power to make a positive impact in others’ lives because that’s exactly what we do here. If you’re seeking a career that taps into your talents in a way that makes the world a better, healthier place, we just may have a job for you.

We know our employees are our most valuable asset, and our culture conveys that. We offer a competitive benefits package, to support the health and happiness of our staff.

Sobi Culture

At Sobi, we refuse to accept the status quo. This is because we have witnessed first-hand the challenges facing those affected by rare diseases, and have used this knowledge to shape our business to find new ways of helping them.

As a specialized biopharmaceutical company, we are dedicated to rare diseases. And we see this focus as a strength. By effectively turning our research into ground-breaking treatments, we help make medicine more accessible and open up more possibilities for patients and more opportunities for those caring for them. This has been our approach since day one, but we know we can’t change the world of rare diseases on our own. Accomplishing this requires strong partnerships with patients, partners and stakeholders across the entire value chain. Together, we define how our business can create solutions that serve the needs of those affected by rare diseases while facilitating sustainable growth.
 An Equal Opportunity Employer

Sobi is an Equal Opportunity Employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. All employment decisions at Sobi are based on business needs, job requirements and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion or belief, national, social or ethnic origin, sex (including pregnancy), age, physical, mental or sensory disability, HIV Status, sexual orientation, gender identity, protected veterans and/or expression, marital, civil union or domestic partnership status, past or present military service, family medical history or genetic information, family or parental status, or any other status or protected groups by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate.
 If you are a qualified individual with a disability or a disabled veteran, you may request a reasonable accommodation if you are unable or limited in your ability to use or access this website to apply for a vacancy as a result of your disability. You can request reasonable accommodations by sending an email to irina.conc@sobi.com
 Know Your Rights

Ruolo e funzione La posizione gioca un ruolo chiave nella valutazione, nella definizione delle priorità e nell'implementazione delle transazioni di sviluppo aziendale in Sobi. Questa persona supporterà progetti e transazioni interfunzionali nell'ambito dello sviluppo aziendale sia a livello globale che regionale. Questo ruolo si concentrerà sia sulla due diligence che sulla gestione dell'alleanza, fornendo anche supporto nella gestione del progetto. Ulteriori responsabilità includono la conduzione di transazioni di sviluppo aziendale a livello regionale, secondo necessità. Questa persona riporterà direttamente al VP, Business Development e Alliance Management con sede negli Stati Uniti, ma supporterà le strategie di transazione stabilite da Sobi a livello globale. Questo ruolo sarà remoto. Mansioni - Collaborare con i membri del team di strategia e sviluppo aziendale per coordinare le attività di due diligence dopo la valutazione iniziale e attraverso tutte le discussioni sullo sviluppo del business. - Guidare e possedere processi di due diligence interfunzionali globali per opportunità di in-licensing, out-licensing, distribuzione e M&A; coordinare tutte le risorse interne ed esterne; stabilire i principali fattori di valore per il business case e gli sforzi contrattuali; gestire il dialogo quotidiano con tutti gli stakeholder interni ed esterni - Stabilire e mantenere attività di database di due diligence interne ed esterne sui progetti assegnati - Supportare lo sviluppo dell'agenda, la gestione delle riunioni e il supporto dei contenuti per il responsabile dello sviluppo aziendale - Guidare gli sforzi per costruire e aggiornare le presentazioni delle capacità aziendali e i requisiti di presentazione esecutiva secondo necessità - Capacità di essere strategici e dare priorità ai progetti chiave per ottenere un impatto ottimale; Forti capacità interpersonali con capacità di guidare, influenzare e gestire progetti e team interfunzionali con molteplici stakeholder diversi, inclusa la leadership senior - Forti capacità strategiche e analitiche con la capacità di definire, inquadrare e riassumere adeguatamente problemi, domande e dati; eseguire valutazioni e analisi accurate dei rischi; e di pensare in modo creativo a diversi modi di analizzare dati e informazioni - Capacità di negoziare internamente con le parti interessate a tutti i livelli, nonché con risorse e controparti esterne - Capacità di stabilire un flusso logico e punti chiave per realizzare obiettivi con eccellenti capacità di presentazione verbale e scritta - Capacità di essere un partner di pensiero per i team di tutta l'azienda - Capacità di gestire informazioni e dati riservati con la massima cura e dimostrazione dei più elevati standard etici - Viaggi nazionali e internazionali fino al 20% Attributi personali Orientamento al team, desiderio di apprendere e lavorare con un'ampia varietà di persone e background, qualcuno che può influenzare, capacità di rimanere concentrato ma equilibrato su più progetti, conforto con l'ambiguità, guidato dall'organizzazione e dall'attenzione ai dettagli, qualcuno con un'ampia conoscenza funzionale e aziendale.
• Requisiti - Laurea triennale o equivalente. Preferibile MBA o titolo avanzato correlato. - Minimo 5 - 7 anni di esperienza nel settore farmaceutico/medico e/o esperienza altamente correlata nella consulenza, nell'investment banking o negli investimenti di private equity - Competenza, esperienza e conoscenza dei processi di due diligence - Esperienza di negoziazione - Esperienza di Alliance Management - Forti capacità di gestione dei progetti e comprensione dei principali strumenti di gestione dei progetti utilizzati - Ottima conoscenza di Microsoft Excel, Microsoft PowerPoint e degli strumenti di gestione dei progetti (ad esempio Smartsheet) richiesti Cosa offerta In Sobi, ci impegniamo a fornire ai nostri dipendenti una ricompensa totale completa e competitiva nel settore pacchetto. La nostra filosofia retributiva è progettata per riconoscere e premiare il talento, garantendo che i tuoi contributi siano valorizzati e riflessi nei tuoi compensi complessivi. Il tuo compenso totale in Sobi va oltre il semplice stipendio base e il bonus annuale. Include anche una vasta gamma di vantaggi, come: - Una partita 401 (k) competitiva per supportare il tuo futuro finanziario. - Rimborsi tasse scolastiche e benessere per investire nella tua crescita personale e professionale. - Un pacchetto completo medico, odontoiatrico e oculistico per dare priorità alla tua salute e al tuo benessere. - Ulteriori premi di riconoscimento per celebrare i tuoi risultati. L'intervallo di stipendio base per questo ruolo è XXX - XXX. Ogni singola offerta sarà determinata in base a diversi fattori, tra cui esperienza, qualifiche e posizione. Inoltre, questo ruolo ha diritto a bonus sia a breve che a lungo termine, come delineato nei dettagli del piano. Tutti i dipendenti Sobi devono dimostrare comportamenti in linea con i valori fondamentali di Sobi: cura, ambizione, urgenza, proprietà e partnership. Sei pronto per far parte del team Sobi? Unisciti a una cultura che consente a ogni persona di essere la persona che fa la differenza per le malattie rare. Perché unirsi a noi? Siamo un'azienda globale con oltre 1.900 dipendenti in più di 30 paesi e ci impegniamo a favore delle società in cui operiamo. Con un team di gestione altamente qualificato che dirige le nostre vittorie quotidiane e un consiglio di amministrazione con un track record stellare, siamo pronti ad affrontare le malattie, i disturbi e le avversità del mondo. Le nostre persone credono di avere il potere di avere un impatto positivo nella vita degli altri perché è esattamente ciò che facciamo qui. Se stai cercando una carriera che sfrutti i tuoi talenti in modo da rendere il mondo un posto migliore e più sano, potremmo avere un lavoro adatto a te. Sappiamo che i nostri dipendenti sono la nostra risorsa più preziosa e la nostra cultura lo trasmette.
• Offriamo un pacchetto di vantaggi competitivi, per sostenere la salute e la felicità del nostro personale. Cultura Sobi Noi di Sobi ci rifiutiamo di accettare lo status quo. Questo perché siamo stati testimoni in prima persona delle sfide che devono affrontare le persone affette da malattie rare e abbiamo utilizzato questa conoscenza per modellare la nostra attività per trovare nuovi modi per aiutarli. In qualità di azienda biofarmaceutica specializzata, ci dedichiamo alle malattie rare. E vediamo questa attenzione come un punto di forza. Trasformando efficacemente la nostra ricerca in trattamenti innovativi, contribuiamo a rendere la medicina più accessibile e ad aprire più possibilità ai pazienti e più opportunità a coloro che si prendono cura di loro. Questo è stato il nostro approccio fin dal primo giorno, ma sappiamo che non possiamo cambiare il mondo delle malattie rare da soli. Per raggiungere questo obiettivo sono necessarie forti collaborazioni con pazienti, partner e parti interessate lungo l’intera catena del valore. Insieme, definiamo come la nostra azienda può creare soluzioni che soddisfino le esigenze delle persone affette da malattie rare, facilitando al tempo stesso una crescita sostenibile. Un datore di lavoro che garantisce pari opportunità Sobi è un datore di lavoro che garantisce pari opportunità e proibisce discriminazioni e molestie di qualsiasi tipo. Tutte le decisioni sull'assunzione in Sobi si basano su esigenze aziendali, requisiti lavorativi e qualifiche individuali, indipendentemente da razza, colore, religione o convinzioni personali, origine nazionale, sociale o etnica, sesso (inclusa la gravidanza), età, disabilità fisica, mentale o sensoriale, stato HIV, orientamento sessuale, identità di genere, veterani e/o espressioni protetti, stato coniugale, unione civile o convivenza, servizio militare passato o presente, storia medica familiare o informazioni genetiche, stato familiare o genitoriale o qualsiasi altro stato o gruppo protetto dalle leggi o dai regolamenti nei luoghi in cui operiamo. Contatto Se sei una persona qualificata con disabilità o un veterano disabile, puoi richiedere una sistemazione ragionevole se non sei in grado o hai capacità limitate di utilizzare o accedere a questo sito web per presentare domanda per un posto vacante a causa della tua disabilità. Puoi richiedere soluzioni ragionevoli inviando un'e-mail a irina.conc@sobi.com Conosci i tuoi diritti

Rolle und Funktion Die Position spielt eine Schlüsselrolle bei der Bewertung, Priorisierung und Umsetzung von Geschäftsentwicklungstransaktionen bei Sobi. Diese Person wird funktionsübergreifende Projekte und Transaktionen innerhalb der Geschäftsentwicklung sowohl global als auch regional unterstützen. Diese Rolle wird sich sowohl auf Due Diligence als auch auf Allianzmanagement konzentrieren und gleichzeitig Projektmanagementunterstützung bieten. Zu den weiteren
• Aufgaben gehört die Leitung von Geschäftsentwicklungstransaktionen auf regionaler Ebene nach Bedarf. Diese Person berichtet direkt an den Vizepräsidenten für Geschäftsentwicklung und Allianzmanagement mit Sitz in den USA, unterstützt jedoch die von Sobi weltweit festgelegten Transaktionsstrategien. Diese Rolle wird remote sein. Mansioni – Zusammenarbeit mit Mitgliedern des Strategie- und Unternehmensentwicklungsteams zur Koordinierung von Due-Diligence-Aktivitäten nach der ersten Bewertung und während aller Geschäftsentwicklungsgespräche – Leitung und Leitung globaler funktionsübergreifender Due-Diligence-Prozesse für Einlizenzierungen, Auslizenzierungen, Vertriebs- und M&A-Möglichkeiten; alle internen und externen Ressourcen koordinieren; Festlegung wichtiger Werttreiber für Geschäftsszenarien und Vertragsbemühungen; Verwalten Sie den täglichen Dialog mit allen internen und externen Stakeholdern. - Erstellen und pflegen Sie interne und externe Due-Diligence-Datenbankaktivitäten für zugewiesene Projekte. - Unterstützen Sie die Agendaentwicklung, das Meeting-Management und die Inhaltsunterstützung für die Geschäftsentwicklung. Führen Sie die Bemühungen zum Aufbau und zur Aktualisierung von Präsentationen zu Unternehmensfähigkeiten und Präsentationsanforderungen für Führungskräfte nach Bedarf. - Fähigkeit, strategisch vorzugehen und Schlüsselprojekte zu priorisieren, um optimale Ergebnisse zu erzielen. Starke zwischenmenschliche Fähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, funktionsübergreifende Projekte und Teams mit mehreren unterschiedlichen Interessengruppen, einschließlich Führungskräften, zu leiten, zu beeinflussen und zu verwalten. - Starke strategische und analytische Fähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, Probleme, Fragen und Daten angemessen zu definieren, zu formulieren und zusammenzufassen; um eine genaue Risikobewertung und -analyse durchzuführen; und kreativ über verschiedene Arten der Daten- und Informationsanalyse nachzudenken - Fähigkeit, intern mit Stakeholdern auf allen Ebenen sowie mit externen Ressourcen und Kollegen zu verhandeln - Fähigkeit, logische Abläufe und Schlüsselpunkte zur Verwirklichung von Zielen mit hervorragenden mündlichen und schriftlichen Präsentationsfähigkeiten zu etablieren - Fähigkeit, ein durchdachter Partner für Teams im gesamten Unternehmen zu sein - Fähigkeit, mit vertraulichen Informationen und Daten mit größter Sorgfalt umzugehen und höchste ethische Standards zu demonstrieren - Inländische und internationale Reisen bis zu 20 % Persönliche Eigenschaften Teamorientiert, lernbegierig und bereit, mit einem zu arbeiten eine große Vielfalt an Menschen und Hintergründen, jemand, der Einfluss nehmen kann, der in der Lage ist, über mehrere Projekte hinweg konzentriert, aber ausgeglichen zu bleiben, sich mit Unklarheiten auskennt, von Organisation und Liebe zum Detail angetrieben wird, jemand mit umfassenden funktionalen und geschäftlichen Kenntnissen. Voraussetzungen – Ein Bachelor-Abschluss oder ein gleichwertiger Abschluss. MBA oder vergleichbarer weiterführender Abschluss bevorzugt. - Mindestens 5 – 7 Jahre Erfahrung in der pharmazeutischen/medizinischen Industrie und/oder hochgradig relevante Erfahrung in der Beratung, im Investment Banking oder bei Private-Equity-Investitionen Prämienpaket. Unsere Vergütungsphilosophie zielt darauf ab, Talente anzuerkennen und zu belohnen, um sicherzustellen, dass Ihre Beiträge wertgeschätzt werden und sich in Ihrer Gesamtvergütung widerspiegeln. Ihre Gesamtvergütung bei Sobi geht über Ihr Grundgehalt und Ihren Jahresbonus hinaus. Es umfasst außerdem zahlreiche Vorteile, wie zum Beispiel: - Ein kompetitives 401(k)-Match zur Unterstützung Ihrer finanziellen Zukunft. - Erstattungen von Studiengebühren und Wellness, um in Ihr persönliches und berufliches Wachstum zu investieren. - Ein umfassendes medizinisches, zahnmedizinisches und augenärztliches Paket, bei dem Ihre Gesundheit und Ihr Wohlbefinden im Vordergrund stehen. - Zusätzliche Anerkennungspreise zur Würdigung Ihrer Erfolge. Die Grundgehaltsspanne für diese Rolle liegt zwischen XXX und XXX. Jedes einzelne Angebot wird auf der Grundlage mehrerer Faktoren ermittelt, darunter Ihre Erfahrung, Qualifikationen und Ihr Standort. Darüber hinaus hat diese Rolle Anspruch auf kurzfristige und langfristige Boni, wie in den Plandetails beschrieben. Alle Sobi-Mitarbeiter müssen Verhaltensweisen zeigen, die den Grundwerten von Sobi entsprechen: Fürsorge, Ehrgeiz, Dringlichkeit, Eigenverantwortung und Partnerschaft. Sind Sie bereit, Teil des Sobi-Teams zu sein? Werden Sie Teil einer Kultur, die jeden Menschen dazu befähigt, die Person zu sein, die bei seltenen Krankheiten einen Unterschied macht. Warum sollten Sie bei uns mitmachen? Wir sind ein globales Unternehmen mit über 1.900 Mitarbeitern in mehr als 30 Ländern und engagieren uns für die Gesellschaften, in denen wir tätig sind. Mit einem hochqualifizierten Managementteam, das unsere täglichen Erfolge steuert, und einem Vorstand mit einer herausragenden Erfolgsbilanz sind wir bereit, uns den Krankheiten, Leiden und Widrigkeiten der Welt zu stellen. Unsere Mitarbeiter glauben, dass sie die Macht haben, das Leben anderer positiv zu beeinflussen, denn genau das tun wir hier. Wenn Sie auf der Suche nach einer Karriere sind, die Ihre Talente auf eine Art und Weise nutzt, die die Welt zu einem besseren und gesünderen Ort macht, haben wir vielleicht genau den richtigen Job für Sie. Wir wissen, dass unsere Mitarbeiter unser wertvollstes Kapital sind, und unsere Kultur vermittelt dies.
• Wir bieten ein wettbewerbsfähiges Leistungspaket, um die Gesundheit und Zufriedenheit unserer Mitarbeiter zu unterstützen. Sobi-Kultur Bei Sobi weigern wir uns, den Status quo zu akzeptieren. Dies liegt daran, dass wir die Herausforderungen, vor denen die von seltenen Krankheiten Betroffenen stehen, aus erster Hand miterlebt haben und dieses Wissen genutzt haben, um unser Unternehmen so zu gestalten, dass wir neue Wege finden, ihnen zu helfen. Als spezialisiertes biopharmazeutisches Unternehmen widmen wir uns seltenen Krankheiten. Und wir sehen diesen Fokus als Stärke. Indem wir unsere Forschung effektiv in bahnbrechende Behandlungen umsetzen, tragen wir dazu bei, die Medizin zugänglicher zu machen und mehr Möglichkeiten für Patienten und mehr Möglichkeiten für diejenigen zu eröffnen, die sie betreuen. Dies ist seit dem ersten Tag unser Ansatz, aber wir wissen, dass wir die Welt der seltenen Krankheiten nicht alleine verändern können. Um dies zu erreichen, sind starke Partnerschaften mit Patienten, Partnern und Interessengruppen entlang der gesamten Wertschöpfungskette erforderlich. Rôle et fonction Le poste joue un rôle clé dans l'évaluation, la priorisation et la mise en œuvre des transactions de développement commercial au sein de Sobi. Cette personne soutiendra des projets et des transactions interfonctionnels au sein du développement commercial, tant au niveau mondial que régional. Ce rôle sera axé à la fois sur la diligence raisonnable et sur la gestion des alliances, tout en fournissant également un soutien à la gestion de projet. Les responsabilités supplémentaires incluent la direction des transactions de développement commercial au niveau régional, selon les besoins. Cette personne relèvera directement du vice-président du développement commercial et de la gestion des alliances basé aux États-Unis, mais soutiendra les stratégies de transaction définies par Sobi à l'échelle mondiale. Ce rôle sera à distance. Mansioni - Assurer la liaison avec les membres de l'équipe de stratégie et de développement d'entreprise pour coordonner les activités de diligence raisonnable après l'évaluation initiale et tout au long de toutes les discussions de développement commercial - Diriger et posséder des processus de diligence raisonnable interfonctionnels mondiaux pour les opportunités d'obtention de licence, d'attribution de licence, de distribution et de fusion et acquisition ; coordonner toutes les ressources internes et externes ; établir des facteurs de valeur clés pour les efforts de rentabilisation et de passation de contrats ; gérer le dialogue quotidien avec toutes les parties prenantes internes et externes - Établir et maintenir les activités de base de données de diligence raisonnable internes et externes sur les projets assignés - Soutenir l'élaboration de l'ordre du jour, la gestion des réunions et le soutien au contenu pour le responsable du développement commercial - Diriger les efforts visant à créer et mettre à jour les présentations sur les capacités de l'entreprise et les exigences de présentation des dirigeants, selon les besoins - Capacité à être stratégique et à prioriser les projets clés pour obtenir un impact optimal ; Solides compétences interpersonnelles avec capacité à diriger, influencer et gérer des projets et des équipes interfonctionnels avec de multiples parties prenantes diverses, y compris la haute direction - Solides compétences stratégiques et analytiques avec la capacité de définir, cadrer et résumer de manière appropriée les problèmes, les questions et les données ; effectuer une évaluation et une analyse précises des risques ; - Capacité à négocier en interne avec les parties prenantes à tous les niveaux ainsi qu'avec des ressources et des homologues externes - Capacité à établir un flux logique et des points clés pour atteindre les objectifs avec d'excellentes compétences en matière de présentation verbale et écrite - Capacité à être un partenaire de réflexion pour les équipes de l'entreprise - Capacité à gérer les informations et les données confidentielles avec le plus grand soin et à démontrer les normes éthiques les plus élevées - Voyages nationaux et internationaux jusqu'à 20 % Attributs personnels Esprit d'équipe, désir d'apprendre et de travailler avec une grande variété de personnes et d'expériences, quelqu'un qui peut influencer, capacité à rester concentré mais équilibré sur plusieurs projets, à l'aise avec l'ambiguïté, motivé par l'organisation et le souci du détail, quelqu'un avec de vastes connaissances fonctionnelles et commerciales.
• Requisiti - Un baccalauréat ou équivalent. MBA ou diplôme d'études supérieures connexe préféré. - Minimum de 5 à 7 ans d'expérience dans l'industrie pharmaceutique/médicale et/ou une expérience hautement connexe dans le conseil, la banque d'investissement ou l'investissement en capital-investissement - Expertise, expérience et connaissance des processus en matière de diligence raisonnable - Expérience en négociation - Expérience en gestion d'alliance - Solides compétences en gestion de projet et compréhension des principaux outils de gestion de projet utilisés - Forte maîtrise de Microsoft Excel, Microsoft PowerPoint et des outils de gestion de projet (par exemple Smartsheet) requise
• Cosa offriamo Chez Sobi, nous nous engageons à fournir à nos employés un total complet et compétitif dans l'industrie. package de récompenses.
